pages.body:
# Rust — Meta

Dated, current-wipe meta snapshots. Check the newest one for "what's strong right now," then re-verify after each first-Thursday force wipe.

- [[Current Meta — Common Ground (July 2026)]] — **CURRENT.** Consolidated meta for the July 2 → August 6 2026 wipe (Common Ground patch): combat/raid/base meta carries over unchanged, plus what softcore modes + clans + the Apartment Complex change.
- [[Current Meta — Built Different (June 2026)]] — previous wipe (June 4 → July 2 2026, Built Different patch): weapon/armor tier lists, base/raid/economy meta. Superseded but still the source for the unchanged combat detail.

pages.title: Abandoned Cabins
pages.body:
# Abandoned Cabins

A tiny primitive "smallument" — two decayed wooden cabins (green + yellow) joined by a rotting walkway over swamp water. Only spawns in the forest/plains biome. **No radiation**, lowest difficulty in the game, and a reliable early-game stop, mainly for its **free [[Green Keycard]]**.

## Loot & facilities

| Thing | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Normal crates | ~4 | 2 plain + 2 that roll 33% medical / normal / food variants; ~2 per cabin |
| Military crates | 0 | |
| Barrels | ~1 | minimal |
| Recycler | None | nearest recycler is at another monument |
| Radiation | None | totally safe for fresh spawns |
| Sulfur | ~15 | 90% direct pickup / 10% node, ~30–33 m respawn |
| **[[Green Keycard]]** | 1 | spawns on a table in the **yellow** cabin's upstairs — **does not respawn** |

Usable props: sofa, metal shop front, poker table.

## Buildable monument

Abandoned Cabins is one of the rare **buildable** monuments. There's a small no-build core (~1,256 m²) around the two cabins, but the surrounding area and the docks/boardwalk allow limited construction — players sometimes build a base right up against it and use the monument as part of their compound.

## Returning-player tips

- The free **green card** is the headline: grab it, then run a green-card puzzle at [[Satellite Dish]], [[The Dome]], [[Sewer Branch]] or [[Radtown]] to convert it into a [[Blue Keycard]] + [[Blueprint Fragment]].
- The card doesn't respawn, so it's first-come each wipe — check it early.
- Usually empty mid-wipe and zero PvP pressure; an easy detour for sulfur + a card when you're nearby.

Related: [[Keycards]], [[Green Keycard]], [[Blueprint Fragments]], [[Satellite Dish]].

pages.title: Abandoned Supermarket
pages.body:
# Abandoned Supermarket

Classic roadside tier-1/2/3 monument: a small wrecked grocery store. **No radiation**, no-build ~45,238 m². One of the three "roadside trio" stops ([[Oxum's Gas Station]], [[Mining Outpost]]) that anchor every road farming loop — and since the loot reshuffle it carries its own mini-puzzle.

## Loot

| Container | Count | Respawn |
|---|---|---|
| Crates (Basic/Normal/Military mix scales with map tier) | 5 | 30–36 min |
| Food boxes | 5 | 30–36 min |
| Loot barrels (yellow/blue) | 3 | 30–36 min |
| Vehicle parts crates | 2 | 30–36 min |
| **Military crate (puzzle-locked)** | 1 | puzzle |
| **[[Green Keycard]]** | 1 | puzzle/never |

Food boxes inside the shelving aisles make it the best early-game food stop. The back office/roof area holds the keycard spawn and puzzle reward.

## Puzzle & extras

- A small switch/fuse-style puzzle (added in the 2025/26 monument refresh) gates **1 Military Crate** plus parked vehicles: **1 Motorbike and 1 Bicycle** spawn behind the puzzle (one-time per reset).
- 1 **monument recycler (5 s / 120%)** on site — recycle your road components here instead of hauling to [[Outpost]] (80%).
- 2 light switches, telephone, hobo barrel, 2 zipline points.

## Route value

Supermarket → [[Oxum's Gas Station]] → [[Mining Outpost]] along a road, recycling at each, is still the canonical day-1 scrap loop. Patrol Helicopter **can** crash here; no Chinook zone, no tunnel entrance.

pages.title: Airfield
pages.body:
# Airfield

A sprawling runway monument with hangars, a control tower, and an underground bunker puzzle. Mid-tier loot, light NPC presence (3 scientists), **2 recyclers**, and a [[Underground Tunnels]] entrance — one of the better "live nearby and farm daily" monuments.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Large / Tier 2-3 |
| Radiation | median 11, max 11 — a burlap+jacket kit or Hazmat is fine everywhere |
| Scientists | 3 Airfield Scientists (respawn only with the puzzle) |
| Keycards/fuses | 2 [[Electric Fuse]]s, 1 [[Green Keycard]], 1 [[Blue Keycard]], 1 timer |
| Recyclers | **2** (monument recyclers, 5s / 120%) |
| Facilities | Repair Bench, Research Table, Small Oil Refinery, elevator, 4 ziplines |
| Events | Chinook drop zone (helipad), Patrol Heli crash site, tunnel entrance |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |

## Loot summary

- 18 open crates (30-36 min respawn) across hangars, tower, and apron
- 8 puzzle-locked crates (7 mixed Normal/Military + 1 barrel) in the bunker
- 6 oil barrels + 5 loot barrels + 3 cave crates
- Puzzle rewards include **1 [[Red Keycard]], 2 Basic Blueprint Fragments, 3 Diesel Fuel**

**Scrap value of a run (est.):** ~150-250 scrap per lap counting components recycled on-site (2 recyclers means you bank value immediately).

## Puzzle walkthrough (underground bunker)

**Bring:** **2 fuses**, Green + Blue keycards, something for 3 scientists. (rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: **2 fuses + green + blue, 1 timer**.)

**Fuse/timer order (the explicit route):**
1. The bunker entrances are the **doorways dug into the embankment behind the hangars** (trench side). Head down the stairs.
2. **Fuse room** at the bottom of the stairs: insert **fuse #1**, hit the **timer**, and swipe **[[Green Keycard|Green]]** at the first card door.
3. Move through the tunnels (clear the 3 scientists here — they hold the corridors), insert **fuse #2** at the second box.
4. Swipe **[[Blue Keycard|Blue]]** at the far door: the loot room holds 7 mixed crates + 1 barrel, **[[Red Keycard]] on the desk**, 2 Basic Fragments, and 3 diesel.
5. Surface, recycle components at either recycler, repeat in ~30 min.

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes — one of the best "live nearby and farm daily" red-card monuments for a solo. Only 3 scientists, rad max 11 (a burlap+jacket kit is enough — no Hazmat needed), 2 recyclers to bank value on-site, and a [[Underground Tunnels]] entrance for safe extraction. The only cost is two fuses and both lower cards. Cheaper-per-run than [[Power Plant]] only if you have spare fuses.

## PvP notes

- The runway is a sniper's alley — cross via the hangars, never down the centerline.
- Control tower is the classic overwatch spot (sees both recyclers and the road); clear it or avoid silhouetting yourself.
- Hangar roofs hide rats watching the bunker entrances; check corners when surfacing with full inventory.
- The tunnel entrance makes Airfield a favorite roam target — keep your exit loose.

## Cross-links

[[Train Yard]] · [[Power Plant]] · [[Blue Keycard]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Recycler]] · [[Patrol Helicopter]]

pages.title: Arctic Research Base
pages.body:
# Arctic Research Base

Snow-biome medium monument: 10 scientists, two [[Blue Keycard]] doors, a free **Snowmobile**, and (post-2026 loot pass) a [[Red Keycard]] + 2 Basic Blueprint Fragments behind the puzzle. The arctic's answer to [[Airfield]] — underrated because nobody wants to live in the snow.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Medium / Tier 1-2-3 mixed loot |
| Radiation | median 3, max 11 — almost none; cold is the real hazard (warm clothes/Hazmat) |
| Scientists | 10 Arctic Research Base Scientists |
| Recyclers | 1 (monument recycler) |
| Vehicles | 1 **Snowmobile** (blue-card garage) |
| Heat sources | 25 (you won't freeze mid-run) |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min (snowmobile garage: instant) |
| No-build zone | 61,575 m² |

## Loot summary

- **23 crates**: 5 Tier-3 Components/Ammunition crates, 6 Underwater-Lab-table Normal crates, 4 Normal/Military (50/50), 4 Food, 4 Fuel
- **24 barrels** (14+5 loot, 5 oil)
- Puzzle 1 ([[Blue Keycard]]): **1 [[Red Keycard]], 2 Basic Blueprint Fragments, 4 Military/Normal crates**
- Puzzle 2 ([[Blue Keycard]]): the **Snowmobile garage** — instant reset

**Scrap value of a run (est.):** ~150-250 scrap equivalent; the T3-table component crates make it punch above its size.

## Run walkthrough

**Bring:** 1-2 [[Blue Keycard]]s (two separate swipe doors), gun for 10 scientists, warm kit.

1. Approach along the ridge, not the open snowfield — the scientists patrol between the huts and the main two-story building and will aggro at range.
2. Clear hut-to-hut using the buildings as cover; the interior heat sources let you camp out your cold bar.
3. **Main building:** swipe **Blue** → loot room with the 4 crates, **Red Keycard**, and 2 Basic Fragments.
4. **Garage:** second **Blue** swipe pops the Snowmobile — your extraction vehicle (snowmobiles are fast on snow, sluggish off it).
5. Recycle at the on-site recycler or haul home; helipad area has the fuel/food crates.

(rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: both puzzles are **blue-card-only, no fuse, no switches** — puzzle 1 gives the red card + 2 fragments + 4 crates; puzzle 2 gives the snowmobile, instant reset.)

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes if you live arctic-adjacent — it's a reliably *uncontested* red-card source because nobody wants to base in the snow. 10 scientists is the catch (more than WTP/Airfield), but rad is near-zero and you need no fuse and no green card — just a blue card for both doors. The free snowmobile is your extraction. Solo verdict: a hidden gem, but only if the snow biome is on your doorstep; otherwise the cold-kit logistics and travel time favor [[Water Treatment Plant]].

## PvP notes

- Snow biome = footprints. Anyone can read that the base was just cleared and track your exit line.
- Scientist gunfire carries across the quiet arctic — runs telegraph themselves; be quick.
- The radar-dome hill is the standard counter-sniper perch overlooking the whole base.
- Low traffic on most servers makes ARB a reliable uncontested red-card source if you live arctic-adjacent.

## Cross-links

[[Blue Keycard]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Snowmobile]] · [[Airfield]] · [[Workbench]]

pages.title: Bandit Camp
pages.body:
# Bandit Camp

Swamp-stilt [[Safe Zones|safe zone]] run by bandit guards. Home of the **casino**, the **Air Wolf helicopter shop**, the **black-market weapons vendor**, and (since the 2025/26 reshuffle) the **keycard vendor**. No radiation, no-build area ~70,685 m². Hostile rules apply (weapon out = shot by guards). Sometimes merges with [[Outpost]] into one combined compound.

## Utilities

| Facility | Count |
|---|---|
| Recycler (safe-zone type: 8 s / 80% — see [[Safe Zones]]) | 2 |
| Repair Bench | 1 |
| Research Table | 1 |
| Workbench Level 1 | 1 |
| Drone Marketplace terminal | 1 |
| Clan table, metal shopfront, 3 hobo barrels | — |

One of the recyclers is tucked away from the main drag (in/behind a stilt hut on the camp's edge) — usually quieter.

## Key vendors (base prices; demand pricing applies)

### Air Wolf (helicopters)
| Vehicle | Price |
|---|---|
| [[Minicopter]] | 750 scrap |
| Scrap Transport Helicopter | 1,250 scrap |
| [[Attack Helicopter]] (Sep 2023; pilot + gunner, rocket pods) | 2,250 scrap |

### Scrap 4 Sale — keycards (moved here from Outpost)
| Card | Price |
|---|---|
| [[Green Keycard]] | 15 scrap |
| [[Blue Keycard]] | 40 scrap |
| [[Red Keycard]] | 80 scrap |

(Older guides say red cards can't be bought — that changed with the 2026 monument/loot reshuffle. Prices float with demand.)

### Black-market weapons
| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| LR-300 Assault Rifle | 500 scrap |
| M39 Rifle | 400 scrap |
| M92 Pistol | 250 scrap |
| Spas-12 Shotgun | 250 scrap |
| Night Vision Goggles | 250 scrap |
| Variable Zoom Scope (4x/8x/16x) | 300 scrap |
| F1 Grenade | 8 scrap |

### Vehicle parts
Medium pistons/valves/spark plugs 40 · Medium crankshaft/carburetor 65 · Modular Car Lift 150 · Hot Air Balloon Armor 70 scrap. Also farming/food/building-supply machines (15–500 scrap range).

## The casino

| Game | Details |
|---|---|
| **Big Wheel** | 25 segments: **12× "1", 6× "3", 4× "5", 2× "10", 1× "20"**. Hit chances 48% / 24% / 16% / 8% / 4%. Wins pay bet × number. Expected return: ~96% on 1/3/5 bets, 88% on 10, 84% on 20 — **bet 1, 3, or 5 if you must; house always edges you long-run** |
| Slot machines | 3 machines, scrap in/scrap out |
| Poker | 5 tables, player-vs-player Texas Hold'em (house takes no rake; this is the only +EV "gambling" if you're better than your table) |
| Blackjack | At [[Outpost]] (1 machine) and the Floating City casinos ([[Deep Sea]]) |

Classic scrap strategy: wheel-gamble only what you'd happily lose; the wheel is a scrap sink, poker is a scrap transfer.

## Missions

**Lumberjack** NPC offers four missions (gathering/hunting chains that pay scrap and items).

## Returning-player notes

- Attack Heli was nerfed Nov 2025: flares no longer fool homing missiles and you can't repair in flight — budget for losses.
- Buying [[Blue Keycard]]s here (40 scrap) trivializes blue puzzles early-wipe, but the green-tier puzzles at [[The Dome]] / [[Satellite Dish]] / [[Sewer Branch]] / [[Radtown]] also *award* blue cards + a Basic [[Blueprint Fragments|Blueprint Fragment]] — often better value than buying.
- CCTV: casino + weapon-shop feeds available from any Computer Station.

pages.title: Caves
pages.body:
# Caves

Natural cave systems scattered across the map in three sizes — **Small, Medium, and Large** — each with a different layout. No radiation. They hold modest loot (food crates, barrels, mine carts, mine crates, ore nodes) but their real value is that they're **buildable**: a rare monument where you can wall off the entrances and build a hidden base inside.

## Cave types

| Type | Layout | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Small | Short single passage | Quickest to seal for a stash/raid-base |
| Medium | Branching tunnels | More flat build surfaces |
| Large | Sprawling multi-level | Most build room; harder to fully wall off |

## Loot

Inside you'll find **food crates, loot barrels, mine carts, and mine crates**, with ore nodes (stone/metal/sulfur) along the walls. It's low-tier loot — caves are not a primary scrap run; people go in for the ore and the building potential, not the crates.

## Cave bases (the main use)

- Caves have **multiple build sites and flat surfaces**, and you can block the entrances with walls/doors to create a concealed, hard-to-find base.
- Classic solo/duo move: build a small honeycombed base inside a cave so raiders can't easily find or surround it.
- Downsides: limited build volume, awkward geometry, and the entrances are known map features so experienced players check them.

## Returning-player tips

- A cave base trades visibility for being a pain to defend if found — good for a low-profile solo stash, weaker for a main base.
- The ore nodes make caves a decent quiet farm spot early wipe.
- No NPCs spawn inside; the threat is purely other players who wander in.

Related: [[Building]], [[Base Design]], [[Mining Outpost]].

pages.title: Deep Sea Monuments
pages.body:
# Deep Sea Monuments

Added in the **Naval Update (Feb 5, 2026)**: a separate offshore event biome reached by sailing off the **south edge of the map** through a stormy-seas portal transition. Contains the Floating City safe zone, scientist-crewed Ghost Ships with locked crates, and lootable Tropical Islands. Built for the new player-built modular ships.

## Zone rules (verified vs rusthelp.com + Naval Update coverage)

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Access | sail south off the map edge; portal-style load into the Deep Sea biome |
| Vehicles | designed for player-built ships and the PT Boat; **RHIBs are banned** from the zone |
| Building | **no building anywhere** in the biome (Tropical Islands included) |
| Reset cycle | the whole biome **resets periodically (default ~2 hours)** — rough seas + radiation spike + full loot refresh; countdown shown on the map |
| Loot tier | elite/military grade — the zone is balanced as a high-end event |

Get out before the reset countdown hits zero or the radiation spike will kill lingering crews.

## Floating City (1-4 variants)

A Tier 3 **safe zone** (18,928 m² no-build, no radiation) that merges [[Outpost]], [[Bandit Camp]], and [[Fishing Village]] services in one place:

- **3 safe-zone recyclers** (8s / 80% yield)
- Vending economy (restocks every 10 s): weapons (e.g. **LR-300 for 500 scrap, M92 for 250 scrap**), turrets, diving gear, boats/maritime supplies (50-250 scrap), clothing, consumables
- **Fish Exchange** — converts catches to scrap (30-75 per trade): pairs with the overfishing/fishing economy
- **Casino row**: 4 slot machines, 4 poker tables, blackjack, arcade games
- 42 farm-plant spawns (pumpkin/corn, 10-min respawn) and 2 water catchers
- "Floating Citizen" NPC offering the *Gone Killing* mission

Treat it as your forward base between Ghost Ship hits — bank loot through the recyclers before the biome reset.

## Ghost Ships (A-D)

- Stationary derelict ships scattered through the biome, **crewed by scientists on deck plus patrol-boat scientists** around them.
- Standard crates on deck and in holds; **some Ghost Ships carry a [[Locked Crate]]** — hack it (15 min) and defend against both scientist boats and rival ships. Contents are military-grade: rifles, explosives, high-tier components (comparable to the Cargo/Oil Rig locked crate).
- Approach: cannon down the scientist patrol boats first (player-ship cannons), then board. The deck fight is exposed — clear from your ship before climbing.

## Tropical Islands (1-4)

- Loot-only islands (crates, barrels, possibly diesel) — **no building**, so they're pit stops, not bases.
- Useful as cover/anchor points while waiting out a locked-crate timer.

## PvP notes

- Everything here assumes naval combat: player-built ships with **cannons** fighting over Ghost Ships. Bring hull repair materials (no in-zone building means no respawn fallback — keep a bag on a [[Tugboat]]/ship bed).
- The ~2 h reset is the strategic clock: hit Ghost Ships right after a reset for fresh loot and before rivals arrive.
- Solos: the Fish Exchange + casino + recycler loop inside Floating City is a viable zero-combat scrap economy.

## Cross-links

[[Boat Building Station]] · [[Cargo Ship]] · [[Locked Crate]] · [[Large Oil Rig]] · [[Outpost]] · [[Recycler]]

pages.title: Ferry Terminal
pages.body:
# Ferry Terminal

Oceanside monument (added 2023, given a proper keycard puzzle in the 2026 monument reshuffle). Like [[Harbor]], it's a no-NPC, no-radiation Green-puzzle monument that pays a **[[Blue Keycard]]** — a safe first rung on the keycard ladder, with a car lift and repair bench as bonuses.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Oceanside / Tier 1-2 |
| Radiation | none |
| Scientists | none |
| Recyclers | 1 (monument recycler) |
| Facilities | Modular Car Lift, Repair Bench, Research Table, elevator, tunnel entrance |
| CCTV | 4 feeds: Dock, Logistics, Parking, Utilities |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |
| No-build zone | 125,663 m² |

## Loot summary

- 10 standard crates (T2-3 maps: 66.7% Normal / 33.3% Military) + 2 puzzle crates
- 26 loot barrels + 6 oil barrels
- Puzzle rewards: **1 [[Blue Keycard]], 1 Basic Blueprint Fragment, 2 Normal Crates**

**Scrap value of a run (est.):** ~100-150 scrap equivalent per lap (barrels + crates through the recycler) — modest, but zero-risk from PvE.

## Puzzle walkthrough

**Bring:** 1 [[Electric Fuse]], 1 [[Green Keycard]].

1. Insert the fuse in the utilities-side fuse box and flip the **switch**.
2. Swipe **Green** at the terminal security door.
3. Loot the locked office: **Blue Keycard + 1 Basic Fragment + 2 crates**. ~30 min reset.

## Why it matters post-2026

The Nov 2025 progression rework made Basic Blueprint Fragments the gate to [[Workbench]] T2 (5 needed), and the reshuffle removed the Outpost Blue-card vendor. Ferry Terminal + [[Harbor]] green puzzles are now the standard solo route to both: ~3-4 quiet laps = a Blue card in hand and fragments banked.

## PvP notes

- The terminal roof and the gantry over the dock are the only real overwatch — check them on approach.
- The car lift attracts vehicle owners mid-wipe; the parking lot is the common fight zone.
- CCTV ("DOCK", "PARKING"...) can be watched from any Computer Station — scout it from home before a loaded run.
- Tunnel entrance = clean extraction when the coast road is hot.

## Cross-links

[[Harbor]] · [[Green Keycard]] · [[Blue Keycard]] · [[Workbench]] · [[Recycler]]

pages.title: Fishing Villages
pages.body:
# Fishing Villages

Coastal [[Safe Zones|safe zones]] where you buy **boats, submarines, kayaks, the DPV, diving gear and fishing supplies**, and sell fish for scrap. A map has one **Large Fishing Village** and usually two or three **small Fishing Villages** (A/B/C variants). No radiation, no recyclers, no-build ~49,087 m². Standard safe-zone hostility rules apply.

## What they sell (base prices, demand pricing applies)

### Boat Vendor
| Vehicle | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Kayak | 50 scrap | + Paddle 25 scrap |
| Rowboat | ~200 scrap | Price raised in Feb 2026 [[Naval Update]] (was 125–250) |
| [[RHIB]] | ~400 scrap | Raised from 300 in Naval Update; remodeled, headlight + compass/map screen. Facepunch's Naval devblog lists RHIBs among the "strong boats" that can enter [[Deep Sea]] (alongside player-built ships and PT Boats) |
| Solo Submarine | 200 scrap | Comes with 50 low grade in tank; no sonar |
| Duo Submarine | 300 scrap | Sonar + internal fuel access |
| Torpedoes ×2 | 75 scrap | |
| **DPV (Diver Propulsion Vehicle)** | 200 scrap | Underwater scooter, added Oct 2024 |

Purchased boats spawn in the water behind the vendor and are **reclaimed after 5 minutes** if you don't claim them — no refund. Large villages stock the full lineup; small villages carry the smaller craft (kayak/DPV/torpedoes and diving gear) — check the vendor on your seed.

### Shop Keeper (diving + fishing)
| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Diving Mask | 15 scrap |
| Wetsuit | 20 scrap |
| Diving Fins | 25 scrap |
| Diving Tank | 35 scrap |
| Handmade Fishing Rod | 80 scrap |
| Worms ×5 | 50 scrap |

### Fish Exchange (sell fish → scrap)
| Fish | Scrap |
|---|---|
| Small Trout ×5 | 30 |
| Yellow Perch ×5 | 50 |
| Salmon ×2 | 55 |
| Catfish ×2 | 65 |
| Orange Roughy ×2 | 75 |
| Small Shark ×2 | 90 |

Fishing remains one of the best AFK-ish scrap loops for solos — a rod (80 scrap) + worms pays for itself in a few catches. Beware **overfishing** (Apr 2026): repeated fishing in one spot depletes it temporarily.

## NPCs / missions

- **Fisherman** — "Tackle the day", "Oiled up", "Go Fish"
- **Dive Master** — "Underwater Bounty", "An Important Broadcast", "Shark Hunt" (these gate diving-loot routes; the dive missions hand out diving gear)

## Why you come here

- Cheapest route to [[Oil Rig]]: RHIB or duo sub from the nearest village.
- The Feb 2026 [[Naval Update]] added **Boat Building Stations** (water-placed, build your own modular ships with sails/engines/cannons) — fishing villages remain the place for ready-made boats and are the natural staging point for naval play and [[Deep Sea]] runs.
- Sell-fish + buy-scuba loop feeds underwater labs and shipwreck/dive-site farming.
- No recycler here — haul components to a monument recycler (120% yield) instead; see [[Safe Zones]].

pages.title: Giant Excavator Pit
pages.body:
# Giant Excavator Pit

A colossal bucket-wheel excavator that converts **Diesel Fuel into bulk resources** — the single biggest resource faucet in the game. Guarded by 18 scientists, no keycards needed. Running it broadcasts to the whole server, so it's a commitment.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Large / Tier 2 |
| Radiation | median 11, max 11 — light protection is enough |
| Scientists | 18 Excavator Scientists (respawn with puzzle/reset) |
| Recyclers | 1 (monument recycler) |
| Special | Supply Drop Signal Computer (calls extra airdrops while running) |
| No-build zone | 152,053 m² |

## Excavator yields (per 1 Diesel Fuel = ~2 minutes of runtime)

| Resource (choose ONE per cycle) | Yield per diesel |
|---|---|
| Stones | **10,000** |
| Metal Fragments | **5,000** |
| Sulfur Ore | **2,000** |
| High Quality Metal Ore | **100** |

Diesel sources: 2-4 spawns at most major monuments ([[Airfield]] 3, [[Power Plant]] 3, [[Water Treatment Plant]] 3, [[Missile Silo]] 3, [[Large Oil Rig]] 4), fuel crates, or vendors. A jerry-can stash of 10 diesel = 20,000 sulfur ore — raid-kit scale.

## How to run it

1. Clear the **18 scientists** — they hold the gantries and the operator house. Fight along the arm walkways; they funnel predictably.
2. Climb to the **operator's cab**, insert Diesel Fuel into the engine, and pick your output resource at the control lever.
3. Resources pour into **two output piles at the conveyor ends** — collect with a free inventory (bring a [[Backpack]]).
4. Optional: the **Supply Drop Signal Computer** in the control room calls airdrops to the pit while the machine runs.
5. The running excavator is **audible and visible map-wide** (moving arm + map icon on many servers). Expect visitors by minute 3-4 — defend the two stair approaches or load-and-leave each cycle.

## Loot summary (besides the machine)

- 10 mixed crates (50% basic / 35% normal / 15% military, fast 15-30 min respawn), 3 cave crates, 5 food boxes.
- The monument itself is a mediocre crate farm — you come here for the diesel economy, not boxes.

## PvP notes

- The pit is a bowl: whoever holds the rim holds the monument. Post a lookout topside while the machine runs.
- The output piles are the kill zone — players get greedy standing still while collecting.
- Solo strategy: run **one diesel only** (2 minutes), take 10k stone or 2k sulfur, and leave before counters arrive. Repeatable all day.

## Cross-links

[[Diesel Fuel]] · [[Airfield]] · [[Missile Silo]] · [[Backpack]] · [[Sulfur]] · [[Raiding]]

pages.title: Harbor
pages.body:
# Harbor

Two oceanside variants (Large and Small), reworked April 2024 so the **[[Cargo Ship]] physically docks here** — you can board it from land. Both carry an easy Green puzzle that pays a **[[Blue Keycard]]** — and since Blue cards are no longer sold at [[Outpost]] (2026), Harbors are a primary rung on the keycard ladder.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Harbor Large | Harbor Small |
|---|---|---|
| Tier | 1/2 Oceanside | 1/2 Oceanside |
| Radiation | none | none |
| Scientists | none | none |
| Recyclers | 1 | 1 |
| Crates | 11 (Mil/Normal, T2 area) + 9 (90% Normal, T1 area) + 2 puzzle | 10 (Mil/Normal, T2) + 8 (Normal/Mil, T1) + 2 puzzle |
| Barrels | 35 loot + 10 oil | 30 loot + 10 oil |
| Facilities | Small Oil Refinery, elevator, 3 ziplines, tunnel entrance | Small Oil Refinery, elevator, 8 zipline points |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min | ~30 min |

## Green puzzle (both variants — same recipe)

**Bring:** 1 [[Electric Fuse]], 1 [[Green Keycard]].

1. Insert the fuse in the fuse box by the dockside office building (Small Harbor also needs the adjacent **switch** flipped).
2. Swipe **Green** at the office door.
3. Loot: **1 [[Blue Keycard]], 1 Basic Blueprint Fragment, 2 Normal Crates**.

That's the whole loop — a fuse and a green card (buyable/found at tier-0 monuments) converts into a Blue card every ~30 minutes. Early wipe, chain Harbor → [[Train Yard]]/[[Water Treatment Plant]] for the [[Red Keycard]].

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes — no scientists, no radiation, and the green puzzle hands a guaranteed [[Blue Keycard]] + fragment, which matters now that [[Outpost]] no longer sells blue cards (Oct 2025). 40-45 barrels per lap make it a quiet ~150-250 scrap-equivalent farm even if you skip the puzzle. The one risk window is when [[Cargo Ship]] docks (Apr 2024 rework) — that turns Harbor into a scheduled PvP event; avoid the berth then unless you want the fight.

## Cargo Ship docking (Apr 2024 rework)

- [[Cargo Ship]] periodically steers into the harbor and **docks at the crane berth** for several minutes. While docked, you can board straight from the pier — no boat needed.
- A **departure horn sounds 60 seconds** before it leaves; get off or commit to the ocean loop.
- Docking turns Harbor into a scheduled PvP event: scientists on deck + every crate-hungry team in the quadrant. Watch the cranes — they're pre-aimed sniper nests over the berth.
- Large Harbor's swing bridge / crane layout gives land players elevation over the deck; defenders on the ship hold the container stacks.

## Scrap value & barrel economics

- Harbors are barrel monuments: 40-45 barrels per lap between the two piers is **~80-120 scrap + components** even before crates.
- With the on-site recycler (monument-tier: 5s / 120% yield), a full Harbor lap nets roughly **150-250 scrap equivalent** — quietly one of the best low-risk farm loops for solos.

## PvP notes

- No NPCs and no radiation means all danger is players; the recycler and the puzzle office are the two ambush points.
- The tunnel entrance (Large Harbor) lets you arrive/extract underground — use it when the cargo crowd shows up.

## Cross-links

[[Cargo Ship]] · [[Ferry Terminal]] · [[Green Keycard]] · [[Blue Keycard]] · [[Recycler]] · [[Underground Tunnels]]

pages.title: Junkyard
pages.body:
# Junkyard

Mid-size tier-1/2 monument: a scrap yard with a working **shredder** and magnet crane. **No radiation**, no-build ~90,792 m². The shredder turned Junkyard from a backwater into a real economy monument — you can feed it vehicles (including downed helicopters) for resources and scrap.

## The shredder

- A **magnet crane / Junkyard Shredder** setup: lift a vehicle onto the conveyor, it gets shredded into resources (metal frags, scrap, components depending on what you feed it).
- **8 shreddable pickup trucks** spawn around the yard (10–20 min respawn) — the built-in fuel for the machine.
- **Helicopter shredding** (minicopters/scrap helis/attack helis you fly or tow in) yields roughly **200–500 scrap** per airframe — stealing-and-shredding enemy helis is a legit income line.
- 1 **Modular Car Lift** on site for car work.

## Loot

| Container | Count | Respawn |
|---|---|---|
| Crates — tier 1: Normal; tier 2+: 50% Normal / 50% Military | 10 | 15–20 min |
| Barrels (45% yellow / 45% blue / 10% Diesel Fuel) | 10 | 15–20 min |
| **Diesel Fuel** one-time spawns | 2 | — |
| **[[Green Keycard]]** | 1 | puzzle/never |
| Motorbikes | 7 | one-time |

The diesel spawns feed [[Quarries]] and the Giant Excavator. The 10% diesel barrels make Junkyard one of the better diesel farms.

## Utilities

- **1 monument recycler (5 s / 120%)** — and the monument *produces* recyclables on-site (roadsigns ×3, components from crates), so you can do a closed loop here.
- 2 hobo barrels, 1 green-keycard puzzle door.

## Keycard note (important — it's not a real puzzle)

Junkyard is listed as a "green-card monument" but there is **no fuse box and no card reader to swipe**. The single [[Green Keycard]] is a free collectible that sits on the monument and **respawns on the ~puzzle reset cycle** (rusthelp marks it "never respawn / puzzle-tied"). So Junkyard is a *source* of green cards, not a place you *spend* one. Grab it on every visit — it's free entry to the green-card ladder ([[Satellite Dish]], [[Sewer Branch]], [[The Dome]], [[Radtown]], [[Harbor]]).

## Notes

- Tier 1/2 zone — low rad-suit requirement (none), low gear floor, but the military-crate share on tier-2 maps draws contesters.
- No tunnel entrance; Patrol Helicopter can crash within the yard.
- Pairs well with [[Oxum's Gas Station]] vehicle-parts farming if you're running the car/shredder economy.

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes as a utility stop, not a loot run. No radiation, no scientists; the draw is the free green keycard, the shredder economy (8 shreddable pickups + the ~200-500 scrap heli-shred line), and the 10% diesel barrels. Loot is only 10 + 10 crates, so don't make a special trip for scrap — make it for the green card, diesel, and shredder.

pages.title: Large Oil Rig
pages.body:
# Large Oil Rig

A multi-level offshore platform and the hardest PvE fight in vanilla Rust: **27 scientists** across six levels, a **12-heavy-scientist** crate-defense event, and a locked crate of military loot. No radiation, no recyclers — bring everything, leave by boat fast.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Offshore / Tier 2-3 |
| Radiation | none normally — **floods with radiation 30 min after the crate hack starts** (post-2024 anti-camp mechanic) |
| Scientists | **27** Oil Rig Scientists spread across L0-L6 (rusthelp, Jun 2026) |
| Heavy scientists | **12** arrive by Chinook when the locked crate hack starts (25% each: M249 / Spas-12 / Minigun / Flamethrower) |
| Recyclers | none |
| Keycard spawns | 1 Green Keycard spawns on the rig |
| CCTV | 13 camera codes (pair with a Computer Station to scout before pushing) |
| Puzzle resets | ~65 min (all four puzzles) |
| No-build zone | 4,416 m² |

## Loot summary

- **Crates (rusthelp, Jun 2026)**: 1 Locked Oilrig Crate, 2 Elite Crates, 8 Military Crates, 15 Normal Crates total (7 standard + 5 Medical/Food + 3 puzzle).
- **33 barrels**: 18 loot + 15 oil (fast 15-20 min respawn).
- **4 Diesel Fuel** spawns (feed the [[Giant Excavator Pit]] or sell).
- Locked crate contents are military-grade: rifles, explosives, high-end components.

**Value of a full clear (est.):** the single best loot density per minute in the game — locked crate + 2 elites + 8 mil crates is a full kit-out for a trio, plus hundreds of scrap in components.

## The four puzzles

| # | Needs | Opens | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [[Red Keycard]] (+ surviving 12 heavies) | 1 Locked Crate, 2 Elite Crates, 4 Military Crates | top deck (L6) — the main event |
| 2 | [[Blue Keycard]] | 4 Military Crates | mid-level |
| 3 | [[Green Keycard]] | 3 Normal Crates + 1 Green Keycard respawn | lower decks |
| 4 | 1 [[Electric Fuse]] + button | 2 Normal Crates + 4 barrels | utility room |

## Run walkthrough (standard trio take)

1. **Approach** by RHIB or [[Tugboat]] at the legs on the blind side (check CCTV first if you have the codes). Park the boat where heavies' Chinook strafe won't shred it.
2. **Climb and clear level by level** (L0 → L6). The 27 scientists come in pockets; fight up staircases, never down. Loot green (L3) and blue (L4) puzzle rooms on the way up.
3. **Top deck (L6):** swipe [[Red Keycard]] (no fuse needed for the red door), start the **locked crate hack (15 minutes)**.
4. The hack alerts the server (map event) and calls the **Chinook with 12 heavy scientists** — they rope onto the helipad/top decks. Hold a doorway chokepoint; minigun and flamethrower variants must be killed at range.
5. Loot the crate at 0:00, grab the **2 Elite Crates + 8 military crates**, and **leave immediately** — radiation floods the rig 30 minutes after hack start, and counter-teams arrive by Mini/Attack Heli all game.

**Worth it for a solo?** No — 27 scientists then 12 heavies is the single hardest PvE gauntlet in the game and the map-wide hack notification guarantees counters. This is a trio-minimum money run. Solos should run [[Small Oil Rig]] (15 + 6 heavies) instead and farm [[Underwater Labs]] in the same boat trip.

## PvP notes

- Everyone on the server sees the hack. Expect counters at minute 8-14 — watch the water and the sky.
- Defenders hold the crate room and the helipad stairs; attackers usually rope from an [[Attack Helicopter]] or boat the far legs.
- A cheap insurance play: hack, then hide on a lower leg and let the counter-teams fight the heavies, then third-party.

## Cross-links

[[Small Oil Rig]] · [[Locked Crate]] · [[Heavy Scientist]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Attack Helicopter]] · [[Deep Sea Monuments]]

pages.title: Launch Site
pages.body:
# Launch Site

The biggest, most dangerous land monument in the game. Tier 3, patrolled by the [[Bradley APC]], home to the largest elite-crate haul on the map. End-game teams farm it on repeat; solos can still profit from the edges.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Large / Tier 3 |
| Radiation | median 11, max 52 — full [[Hazmat Suit]] required for the rocket and main building, mild elsewhere |
| Scientists | 8 Launch Site Scientists (around the main puzzle area) |
| Bradley APC | patrols the main road loop; 1,000 HP, ~60 min respawn |
| Recyclers | 1 (monument recycler: 5s / 120%) |
| Other facilities | 1 Repair Bench, 1 Research Table, 1 Small Oil Refinery |
| Tunnel entrance | Yes ([[Underground Tunnels]] access) |
| No-build zone | 92,205 m² |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |

## Loot summary

- **77 crates total**: 3 Elite Crates (puzzle-locked), ~5 Military Crates, ~30 Normal Crates, plus 20 mixed (50% Military / 50% Normal) and 4 mixed (80% Normal / 20% Military) behind the two puzzles.
- **64 barrels** (56 loot + 8 oil) — huge barrel farm along the rocket, warehouses, and parking lots.
- **2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments** in the main puzzle — one of only three land sources of T3 workbench fragments (with [[Missile Silo]] and [[Military Tunnels]]).
- [[Bradley APC]] drops 3 locked, burning APC crates (top-tier weapons/armor/explosives). Crates burn for several minutes before they can be looted — bring water or wait.

**Scrap value of a full run:** community loot guides (Cobalt Lab, Jun 2026) estimate **~568 scrap** for a complete clear of all crates + barrels + puzzle; raw barrel-and-open-crate farming alone is roughly 300-500 scrap before components. rusthelp does not publish a single scrap total (overlapping spawn weights), so treat ~568 as a community figure, not a hard rusthelp number. The puzzle + Bradley add elite-tier weapons/components worth far more than the raw scrap.

## Main puzzle walkthrough (Green + Red)

**Bring:** 1 [[Green Keycard]], 1 [[Red Keycard]], **2 [[Electric Fuse]]s**, guns/meds for 8 scientists, full [[Hazmat Suit]]. (rusthelp puzzle spec, Jun 2026: 1 green + 1 red, **2 fuses, 2 switches**.)

**Switch order (the explicit route):**
1. Work toward the **main rocket assembly building** (the huge multi-floor factory next to the rocket). The 8 scientists patrol this area — clear them from range first.
2. **Fuse box #1** sits in the ground-floor utility room of the main building. Insert fuse #1 and flip **switch #1** next to it.
3. **Fuse box #2** is in the second utility room feeding the upper reader; insert fuse #2 and flip **switch #2**. Both circuits must be live before you swipe — each [[Electric Fuse]] only powers the circuit for ~180 s, so do the swipes promptly.
4. Swipe **[[Green Keycard|Green]]** at the **lower security door** (ground-floor reader). This opens the path up.
5. Climb to the **top-floor locked room** and swipe **[[Red Keycard|Red]]** (you have only 2 red swipes — make this one count; the reader must be powered).
6. Loot: **3 Elite Crates + ~20 mixed crates + 2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments**. Readers de-power when fuses burn out.

Note: the 2024-2026 monument loot reshuffle moved some internals; on your first visit scout fuse-box rooms before committing fuses.

**Worth it for a solo?** The core puzzle + Bradley is a team objective (8 scientists, rad 52, a 1,000-HP [[Bradley APC]], and it's the most-contested PvP spot on the map). But the **outer warehouses and parking-lot barrels are genuinely solo-friendly** — low rad, no scientists, ~300-500 scrap in barrels alone, with the tunnel entrance as a clean escape. Solo verdict: farm the edges yes, run the red room/Bradley only when geared and the server is quiet.

**Secondary puzzle** (no cards): 2 switches + 1 timer + 1 button opens a side room with 4 mixed crates (80% Normal / 20% Military). Free loot if you learn the button route.

## Bradley APC

- 1,000 HP; self-heals to full if left undamaged for 5 minutes, so commit once you start.
- Cheapest reliable kills: ~3 Timed Explosive Charges, ~7 direct Rockets, or 4-7 HV Rockets (bring spares). Fight it from the concrete buildings/silo stairs where it can't shell you.
- Respawns ~60 minutes after death.

## PvP notes

- **The recycler is a death trap** — everyone who farms the warehouses funnels there. Recycle in short batches.
- Roof of the main building and the rocket scaffold are the dominant sightlines; counter-snipers sit on the silo towers outside the rad zone.
- Solo play: farm the **outer warehouses and parking-lot barrels** (low rad, no scientists) and leave the core to teams. The tunnel entrance is your escape hatch.
- Listen for Bradley's engine before crossing the main road; it aggros on every player it sees, geared or naked.

## Cross-links

[[Missile Silo]] · [[Military Tunnels]] · [[Bradley APC]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Workbench]] · [[Recycler]]

pages.title: Lighthouse
pages.body:
# Lighthouse

Tier-1 oceanside micro-monument. **No radiation**, not a safe zone, no-build ~31,415 m². A map usually spawns several. Quick, low-risk loot stop for fresh spawns working the coast — now with a monument recycler and a small switch puzzle.

## Loot

| Container | Count | Respawn |
|---|---|---|
| Loot barrels (41.7% yellow / 41.7% blue / 12.5% food crate / 4.2% medical) | 5 | 30–36 min |
| Oil barrels (41.7% oil / rest yellow-blue) | 5 | 30–36 min |
| Normal crates | 4 | 30–36 min |
| Puzzle-locked crate | 1 | with puzzle reset |
| **[[Green Keycard]] spawn** | 1 | puzzle/never |

Climb the spiral stairs to the top — crates spawn on the balcony levels and at the keeper's hut.

## Utilities

- **1 monument ("Radtown") recycler — 5 s/item, 120% yield** (the good kind; see [[Safe Zones]] for the split). Lighthouse-recycling a coast road run beats hauling to [[Outpost]].
- 3 zipline target points, 2 light switches (the small electrical puzzle gates the extra crate).

## Why bother

- Reliable early [[Green Keycard]] pickup feeding the green→blue puzzle chain ([[The Dome]], [[Satellite Dish]], [[Sewer Branch]], [[Radtown]]).
- Safe recycler access on the coast with almost zero counter-play risk — it's a fresh-spawn economy hub.
- Patrol Helicopter does **not** crash here and there's no Chinook zone; contest risk is purely other beach players.

pages.title: Military Tunnels
pages.body:
# Military Tunnels

The classic PvE gauntlet: 33 scientists guarding an underground lab with **6 elite crates** — the largest elite count of any land monument. Full keycard ladder required (Green → Blue → Red). Moderate radiation.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Large / Tier 3 |
| Radiation | median 11, max 26 — Hazmat sufficient |
| Scientists | 33 Military Tunnel Scientists (the puzzle path forces ~11 fights minimum) |
| Keycards/fuses | 1 [[Electric Fuse]], 1 [[Green Keycard]], 1 [[Blue Keycard]], 1 [[Red Keycard]]; activate 2 timers + 1 switch |
| Recyclers | 1 (monument recycler, outside) |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |
| No-build zone | 138,544 m² |

## Loot summary

- **6 Elite Crates** (red room — never respawn until puzzle reset)
- 4 puzzle-locked Military/Normal crates + 6 open Military/Normal crates (50/50)
- 2 Medical/Food crates, 14 barrels
- **2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments** (puzzle-locked) — T3 [[Workbench]] fuel
- 3 Diesel Fuel (puzzle-locked)

**Value of a full clear (est.):** 6 elites makes this the best guns-per-run land monument; budget 150+ rifle rounds and several medkits for the scientists.

## Puzzle walkthrough

**Bring:** **1 fuse**, Green + Blue + Red keycards (all three, one trip), a real gun (SAR minimum, rifle recommended), meds. (rusthelp puzzle spec, Jun 2026: 1 fuse, green + blue + red, **2 timers + 1 switch**.)

**Switch/timer order (the explicit route):**
1. Enter through the **main tunnel mouth** (vehicle tunnel). Hug the wall and take the scientists in the entry cavern one at a time — sound discipline matters; suppressed weapons keep the deeper pockets calm.
2. First side building inside the tunnel: **fuse room**. Insert the single [[Electric Fuse]], flip the **switch**, and hit **timer #1**.
3. Swipe **[[Green Keycard|Green]]** at the security door nearby; push through the barracks rooms (heaviest scientist density — fight in doorways).
4. Hit **timer #2** en route, then swipe **[[Blue Keycard|Blue]]** at the lab access door.
5. Descend to the underground laboratory and swipe **[[Red Keycard|Red]]**: the elite room holds the **6 Elite Crates + 5 unlocked military/normal crates + 2 Advanced Fragments + 2 Diesel** (rusthelp: puzzle unlocks 3 of the 6 elites + 5 crates; the others are open on the path).
6. Exit via the back/train-side door rather than retracing — fresh scientists respawn with the puzzle and players camp the main mouth.

**Worth it for a solo?** Marginal. 33 scientists on the monument (the puzzle path forces ~11 fights) with rad max 26 means a geared solo *can* clear it, but you'll burn 150+ rifle rounds and several meds, and you carry all three cards (a death loses the whole ladder). Best as a duo. Solo alternative for the same Advanced Fragments at lower risk: a quiet [[Underwater Labs]] red room.

## PvP notes

- Gunfire echoes out of the tunnel mouth; long clears advertise you. Counter-players usually wait at the entrance rather than push in — clear your exit corner-by-corner.
- The monument recycler outside is exposed; recycle after the danger, not mid-run.
- On the 2026 loot tables, MT competes directly with [[Missile Silo]]: Silo = more military crates and worse radiation; MT = more elites and more NPC ammo cost.

## Cross-links

[[Launch Site]] · [[Missile Silo]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Workbench]] · [[Scientist]]

pages.title: Mining Outpost
pages.body:
# Mining Outpost

The smallest of the roadside trio ([[Abandoned Supermarket]], [[Oxum's Gas Station]]) — a wooden warehouse shack. **No radiation**, no-build ~38,751 m². Famous for one thing: the free **Repair Bench**.

## Loot

| Container | Count | Respawn |
|---|---|---|
| Basic crates (tier-1 maps) / Normal crates (tier 2–3) | 4 | 15–20 min |
| Normal crates | 2 | 30–36 min |
| On tier-3 maps: 80% Normal / 20% Military mix | (2 of the above) | — |
| Vehicle parts crates | 2 | 15–20 min |

Total 8 crates — fast respawns (15–20 min) for its size, so it re-loots quickly on a circuit.

## Utilities

| Facility | Notes |
|---|---|
| **Repair Bench** | The classic early-wipe repair stop — repair looted guns/tools for fragments before you own one |
| **1 monument recycler** | 5 s / 120% yield (see [[Safe Zones]]) |
| 2 light switches | Interior lighting |
| Motorbike + bicycle | One-time puzzle-style spawns out front |

No keycard spawn listed here post-reshuffle — it's a loot-and-services stop, not a puzzle monument.

## Route value

- Recycler + repair bench + fast crate respawn in a 20-second footprint: best scrap-per-minute of the small roadsides when uncontested.
- Patrol Helicopter can crash here; no Chinook zone, no tunnel entrance, no safe-zone protection — watch the door sightlines, the single room is a deathtrap when contested.

pages.title: Missile Silo
pages.body:
# Missile Silo

Added May 2023, reworked in the 2026 monument reshuffle: now a **[[Red Keycard]] monument** with 4 elite crates and the highest radiation on the map. An underground bunker descending past a nuclear warhead (the MLRS launch silo), defended by **Heavy Scientists** rather than a swarm of regular ones. The land alternative to [[Large Oil Rig]] for end-game loot.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Medium / Tier 2-3 |
| Radiation | **median 26, max 81** — highest in the game; full [[Hazmat Suit]] mandatory, rad pills for the deep levels |
| Scientists | **27 total** — 23 NVG "inside" scientists (heavy-equivalent: ~300 HP, LR-300/Spas-12, night-vision) + 4 regular scientists guarding the surface keycard building. The 23 NVG interior scientists are the real ammo sink, not a swarm of weak ones. |
| Keycard | 1 [[Red Keycard]] + 1 button |
| Recyclers | none — bring nothing you can't carry out |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |
| No-build zone | 90,792 m² |
| Patrol Heli crashes | allowed on the surface |

> Verified vs rusthelp.com (Jun 2026): 4 Elite Crates · 20 military crates (12 + 8 at mixed weights) · 11 normal crates · 35 crates total · 2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments · 3 Diesel · median rad 26 / max 81 · 23 inside NVG + 4 outside scientists · no recyclers · Red Keycard + 1 button.

## Loot summary (35 crates total)

- **4 Elite Crates** (one sits in the back of a pickup in the bottom cavern)
- **20 military crates + 11 normal crates** through the side rooms and control levels (35 crates total)
- **2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments** — T3 [[Workbench]] fuel (one of the few land sources of advanced fragments)
- 3 Diesel Fuel spawns

**Value of a full clear (est.):** comparable to Large Oil Rig's haul without the boat logistics — 4 elites + 20 military crates + 2 advanced fragments. The cost is ammo (23 NVG scientists at ~300 HP each) and meds (max-81 radiation).

## Run walkthrough

**Bring:** [[Red Keycard]], full Hazmat (or better: rad-insert armor), 2+ stacks of ammo, meds + anti-rad tea/pills, large backpack.

1. **Surface:** clear the **4 regular scientists** guarding the keycard building and silo doors from range.
2. Enter via the **main personnel stairwell** (next to the big silo doors). Fight downward floor by floor — the **23 NVG scientists** (~300 HP each, LR-300/Spas-12) hold hallways and control rooms and tank far more than regular ones; let them push to you in doorways and focus-fire. Budget 250+ rifle rounds.
3. **Control level:** swipe the [[Red Keycard]] (single swipe — no fuse needed) and press the launch-control **button** to open the deep sections (no switches in this puzzle, just card + button).
4. Descend past the **warhead chamber** — this is the max-radiation zone (median 26 / max 81 rads); loot the elite crates fast and rotate out to let your rad meter drain.
5. Sweep the side rooms and bottom cavern for the **20 military crates**, the **4 Elite Crates** (one in the back of a pickup in the bottom cavern), and the **2 Advanced Blueprint Fragments**, then exit the way you came (watch the surface doors — campers love them).

**Worth it for a solo?** No — 23 NVG scientists at ~300 HP each plus max-81 radiation make this a kitted-team monument. A geared solo *can* do it with full Hazmat, a rifle, 250+ rounds and meds, but the ammo/med cost rarely beats running [[Water Treatment Plant]] for a free [[Red Keycard]] and looting [[Small Oil Rig]] instead. Treat Silo as a duo/trio land alternative to [[Large Oil Rig]].

## PvP notes

- One way in, one way out (effectively) — the stairwell is a brutal choke. If you hear gunfire below, you own the exit; if you're inside, you're trapped. Clear fast.
- Gunfire inside is muffled to the surface, but the surface scientists' deaths telegraph that someone's in.
- Radiation is your friend as a defender: naked counters die at the door.

## Cross-links

[[Launch Site]] · [[Military Tunnels]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Hazmat Suit]] · [[Workbench]]

pages.title: Outpost
pages.body:
# Outpost

The main NPC-run [[Safe Zones|safe zone]]: a walled scientist compound with vending machines, recyclers, research/repair stations and a drone marketplace. No radiation. Sentry turrets and scientists kill anyone flagged hostile (weapon out / attacking / looting players). No-build area ~125,663 m². On some map seeds it merges with [[Bandit Camp]] into one combined compound.

**2026 note:** Outpost **no longer sells the Blue Keycard** — keycards moved to the "Scrap 4 Sale" vendor at [[Bandit Camp]] (Green 15 / Blue 40 / Red 80 scrap).

## Utilities

## Missions

## Returning-player tips

- Jackhammer (150 scrap) is the classic no-tool-tree farming buy.

The mid-game bottleneck is [[Blueprint Fragments]] for [[Workbench]] tiers, not scrap.

pages.title: Oxum's Gas Station
pages.body:
# Oxum's Gas Station

Roadside tier-1/2/3 monument — a derelict gas station with a small green-keycard puzzle. **No radiation**, no-build ~45,238 m². Part of the roadside trio with [[Abandoned Supermarket]] and [[Mining Outpost]].

## Loot

| Container | Count | Respawn |
|---|---|---|
| Mixed crates (tier-scaled Normal/Military) | 5 | 15–30 min |
| Food boxes | 5 | 30–36 min |
| Vehicle parts crates | 3 | 30–36 min |
| Cave-type crates | 2 | 30–36 min |
| **Military crate (puzzle reward)** | 1 | puzzle |
| **[[Green Keycard]]** | 1 | puzzle/never |
| Motorbike | 1 | puzzle/one-time |

## The puzzle (green-tier starter)

Oxum's is the classic *first puzzle* of a wipe: flip the **fuse/switch** setup (2 light switches; switch around the back of the building), then take the stairs to the upstairs office for the **Military Crate** + keycard-room loot. Reward also includes the parked motorbike since the 2024 motorbike update.

## Utilities

- **1 monument recycler — 5 s / 120% yield** (vs 80% at safe zones; see [[Safe Zones]]). The recycler sits in the open behind the station — fast but exposed.
- Telephone, toilet (drinkable water), hobo barrel, 2 zipline points, 2 chairs.
- No repair bench (that's [[Mining Outpost]]'s job).

## Route value

Highest vehicle-parts density of the roadside trio (3 crates) — relevant for modular cars and the [[Junkyard]] shredder economy. Patrol Helicopter can crash here; no Chinook, no tunnel entrance.

pages.title: Power Plant
pages.body:
# Power Plant

Tier 3 industrial complex with zero NPCs, **3 recyclers** (most of any monument), and a Green+Blue puzzle paying out a [[Red Keycard]] + 3 Basic Blueprint Fragments + 3 Diesel Fuel. The radiation pockets (max 52) do the guarding instead of scientists.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Large / Tier 3 |
| Radiation | median 0, max 52 — hot only in specific buildings/rooms; full [[Hazmat Suit]] for the puzzle core |
| Scientists | none |
| Recyclers | **3** (monument recyclers, 5s / 120%) |
| Facilities | 2 Repair Benches, 2 Small Oil Refineries, Research Table, elevator, Pump Jack, 3 ziplines |
| Events | tunnel entrance, Chinook drop zone, Patrol Heli crashes |
| Puzzle reset | ~30 min |

## Loot summary

- 15 open crates (60% Normal / 40% Military) + 4 Medical/Food + 10 barrels
- 8 puzzle-locked crates (60/40) + 5 puzzle barrels
- Puzzle rewards: **1 [[Red Keycard]], 3 Basic Blueprint Fragments, 3 Diesel Fuel**

**Scrap value of a run (est.):** ~200-300 scrap/lap — 3 recyclers means everything converts on-site; PP is arguably the best pure component-recycling monument in the game.

## Puzzle walkthrough

**Bring:** 1 [[Electric Fuse]], 1 [[Green Keycard]], 1 [[Blue Keycard]]. (rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: 1 fuse + green + blue, **3 switches + 1 timer**.)

**Switch/timer order (the explicit route):**
1. Power the puzzle: flip the **3 switches** around the main production complex (control rooms of the big buildings — one is up a flight of external stairs; learn the triangle once and it's a ~60-second loop).
2. **Fuse box + timer** room: insert the fuse and hit the **timer** — this energizes the card readers for a limited window, so do steps 3-4 promptly.
3. Swipe **[[Green Keycard|Green]]** at the lower security door of the main building.
4. Climb to the upper-floor locked room and swipe **[[Blue Keycard|Blue]]**: loot the 8 puzzle crates, **[[Red Keycard]]**, **3 Basic Fragments** (the most of any blue puzzle), 3 diesel.
5. Radiation in the core buildings (max 52) is the real timer — rotate out when your geiger screams, drain, re-enter.

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes, with caveats. No scientists at all and **3 recyclers** (most of any monument) make it the best pure component-recycling stop and a safe solo farm — but it costs both a green AND a blue card (75 scrap if bought) to reach the red room, vs. WTP's blue-only. Run PP for the 3 fragments + on-site recycling; run [[Water Treatment Plant]] when you just want the red card cheaply.

## PvP notes

- No NPCs means **silence** — any sound you hear at PP is a player. Conversely, your recycler hum/footsteps carry.
- The twin smokestacks and cooling tower rim are classic sniper perches covering the whole yard.
- Three recyclers split farmers apart, which makes PP safer for solos than single-recycler monuments — pick the recycler with the best escape line to your base.
- The puzzle window (timer + fuse) punishes interrupted runs; clear sightlines before swiping.

## Cross-links

[[Train Yard]] · [[Water Treatment Plant]] · [[Launch Site]] · [[Blue Keycard]] · [[Red Keycard]] · [[Recycler]]

pages.title: Quarries
pages.body:
# Quarries

Three map-static **mining quarries** — Sulfur, Stone, and High Quality Metal — plus the related **Pump Jack**. They are passive resource generators: feed them **[[Diesel Fuel]]** and they grind out raw ore on a timer. No radiation, no NPCs; the danger is players contesting the static spawns. (The map-wide industrial machine is the separate [[Giant Excavator Pit]].)

## Yields per 1 diesel fuel

Processing time is **~2 min 9 s per diesel** for all of them:

| Quarry | Output per diesel |
|---|---|
| **Sulfur Quarry** | 1,000 Sulfur Ore |
| **Stone Quarry** | 5,000 Stones + 1,000 Metal Ore |
| **HQM Quarry** | 50 High Quality Metal Ore |
| **Pump Jack** | 60 Crude Oil + 170 Low Grade Fuel |

Quarries consume roughly **30 diesel per hour** of continuous running. Smelt the ore output in furnaces to get usable Sulfur / Metal Fragments / HQM.

## Running one

1. Get [[Diesel Fuel]] — looted at [[The Dome]] (2), [[Junkyard]] (3), [[Radtown]] (1), Power Plant (2), Water Treatment (3), Oil Rigs (2/3), or bought at [[Outpost]] for **300 Low Grade Fuel**.
2. Pour diesel into the **blue barrels** on the side of the quarry.
3. Climb to the top and start the engine. Output collects in the quarry's output bin.

## Place your own quarry (Survey Charge)

You can deploy your **own** Mining Quarry in non-static map spots:

- Throw a **Survey Charge** (a small beancan-style explosive) on bare ground. If it craters and shows minerals, that spot is viable.
- The readout covers a radius of ~2.5–3.5 building foundations and lists which resources and how much are underground.
- Place a Mining Quarry there and it harvests whatever the survey showed. Pump Jacks work the same for crude/low-grade nodes.

This lets you build a quarry **inside or next to your base**, removing the need to contest the public quarries — a big quality-of-life move for solo/duo farming.

## Returning-player tips

- HQM is the bottleneck resource for armored bases and high-tier guns — the HQM Quarry (or a surveyed HQM node by your base) is the durable way to mass it.
- Public quarries are PvP magnets at the static map locations; surveying your own near base is usually safer.
- Stockpile diesel before a session: 30/hour means a quarry run eats fuel fast.

Related: [[Diesel Fuel]], [[Giant Excavator Pit]], [[Junkyard]], [[The Dome]].

pages.title: Radtown
pages.body:
# Radtown

The classic legacy "Radtown" returned in **World Update 2.0 (Oct 2024)** as a full open-world monument after years out of the game. It's a dense, multi-tier urban-decay sprawl with the highest raw crate count of any minor monument and a green-card puzzle. Median radiation 0, but **max radiation reaches ~26** in the deep tier-3 interior — bring real rad protection (a [[Hazmat Suit]] or radiation-resist gear), unlike the other green-card monuments.

## Loot & facilities

| Thing | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Normal crates | 32 | 12 tier-1 + 8 tier-2 + 12 standard — huge volume |
| Military crates | 12 | 10 in tier-3 + 2 puzzle reward |
| Elite crates | 0 | (no red-tier loot here) |
| Foodboxes | 12 | |
| Vehicle-parts containers | 3 | |
| Barrels | 15 | 50% yellow / 50% blue |
| Recycler | 1 | **Radtown type: 5 s/item, 120% yield** ([[Safe Zones]]) |
| [[Diesel Fuel]] | 2 | |
| Radiation | Median 0 / **max 26** | the hottest of the minor monuments |

## Green-card puzzle

Bring **1 [[Green Keycard]]** + **1 [[Electric Fuse]]**: activate the switch to open the puzzle room.

**Reward (resets ~30 min):** **1 [[Blue Keycard]]**, **1 Basic [[Blueprint Fragment]]**, 2 military crates. There's also a free Blue Keycard collectible on a table inside. (rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: 1 fuse + 1 green card, **1 switch**.)

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes for loot volume, with a caveat. No scientists, 1 switch, and the highest raw crate count of any minor monument (rusthelp: ~20 normal + ~20 military across tiers + 12 foodboxes + 15 barrels). The catch is the deep interior hits **rad 26** — the only green monument where you genuinely need a [[Hazmat Suit]], not just clothing. Bring rad gear and storage; skip it naked.

## Returning-player tips

- Best pure-volume scrap/component farm of any minor monument — 32 normal + 12 mil crates + 12 foodboxes. Bring storage.
- The deep interior hits rad ~26: don't run it naked. This is the one green-card monument where you genuinely need rad gear.
- Part of the 2024–2026 monument reshuffle that reworked loot tables for the first time in 5+ years — Radtown, [[Ferry Terminal]] and [[The Dome]] all got new puzzles.

Related: [[World Update 2.0]], [[Keycards]], [[Blueprint Fragments]], [[Hazmat Suit]].

pages.title: Ranch and Large Barn
pages.body:
# Ranch and Large Barn

The two **stables** [[Safe Zones|safe-zone]] monuments. **Ranch** = small red building with a row of cement-walled stables; **Large Barn** = big red barn with hay-bale stacks (no-build ~22,698 m²). Both are turret-defended safe zones with a **Stables Shopkeeper** NPC at a front window. No radiation, **no recycler, no workbench**.

## Stables Shopkeeper (base prices, 10 s restock)

| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Single Horse Saddle | 75 scrap |
| Double Horse Saddle (seats 2) | 90 scrap |
| Roadsign Horse Armor | 100 scrap |
| High Quality Horse Shoes | 40 scrap |

Buying a saddle here is the standard way to get a ridable horse with decent stats; wild [[Horses]] spawn everywhere (except water/snow/tunnels/monuments) and are free but stat-random.

### Flower trade (for farming/bees)
| Trade | Restock |
|---|---|
| 12 Roses for 50 scrap | 15 min |
| 1 Sunflower for 3 scrap | 5 min |
| 1 Orchid for 8 scrap | 10 min |

## Horses in 2026 (post-Feb 2025 overhaul)

- Horses **swim**, navigate properly, and can **tow siege weapons** (Catapult, Ballista, Battering Ram — see [[Siege Weapons]]).
- **Saddle bags**: +6 slots each, up to 2 per horse (12 total), −3.6 km/h speed each.
- Horse **armor** (roadsign) reduces damage taken; **HQ horse shoes** raise speed.
- Horses take **impact damage** from collisions at speed (Feb 2025).
- You can heal a horse with **Medical Syringes**, even while mounted/moving (Nov 2025).
- Feed: grass auto-grazing, or hay/pumpkins/corn for faster stamina + health regen. Horse poop is a fertilizer source for [[Farming]] composters.

## Missions

**Hunter** NPC (Large Barn): "Deer Hunt", "Boar Hunt", "Vagabond Treasure".

## Why you come here

- Cheapest early-wipe mobility: 75 scrap saddle beats a 750-scrap [[Minicopter]] until mid-wipe.
- Siege-weapon logistics for raids ([[Siege Weapons]] towing) make stables relevant again post-Feb-2025.
- Flower vendor is a shortcut into the bee/honey and mixing-table economy ([[Farming]]).
- Zero recycling/loot here — it's a shop stop, not a farm spot. 3 zipline points + telephone at Large Barn.

pages.title: Roadside Junk Piles
pages.body:
# Roadside Junk Piles

Not a true monument — randomly generated **clusters of junk** that spawn along roads, on shorelines, and floating on water. They're the backbone of the early-game **road run**: a loop along roads hitting junk piles and barrels for scrap and components before you can fight for monuments.

## What spawns

| Pile type | Contents |
|---|---|
| Road / land junk pile | 1–4 barrels, occasionally 1 food crate or large crate |
| Junk Truck Pile | wrecked truck near roads/transmission towers; barrels + scrap pickups |
| Floating (water) junk pile | 1–2 barrels (1–2 scrap each) + crates (5–10 scrap), occasionally an elite crate (~25 scrap) |

Piles are randomly generated and **reset roughly every 20 minutes**.

## Barrels (the core unit)

- Barrels have **35 HP** — two melee hits or a couple of pistol rounds.
- Each barrel yields about **2 scrap** plus low-tier components (metal pipe, gears, springs, sheet metal, rope, etc.) and sometimes wood/cloth/leather.
- Recycle the components at any monument **Radtown recycler** (5 s/item, 120% yield — see [[Safe Zones]]) for more scrap.

## The road run (returning-player core loop)

1. Pick a road, run it on foot or a bike, smashing every barrel and junk pile.
2. Carry the components, then recycle them at a monument recycler ([[Mining Outpost]], [[Satellite Dish]], etc.) for scrap.
3. Use the scrap for research (15/30/60/120 by tier post-Nov 2025) and to buy keycards at [[Bandit Camp]].

This is the no-PvP, no-NPC way to bootstrap a wipe — junk piles + barrels feed your first [[Workbench]] and tool-tree progress. Watch the floating piles too; their elite crates are a small scrap bonus.

Related: [[Scrap]], [[Recyclers]], [[Safe Zones]], [[Getting Started]].

pages.title: Rust Monuments
pages.body:
# Rust Monuments

Master tier table for every monument in Rust (as of the June 2026 "Built Different" patch). Major (tier 2/3) monuments each have a full page in this folder; tier 0/1 and special monuments are covered by the small-monuments pages.

**The keycard ladder:** Green puzzles award [[Blue Keycard]]s; Blue puzzles award [[Red Keycard]]s; Red puzzles guard elite loot. Since the 2025-2026 monument reshuffle, the [[Blue Keycard]] is **no longer sold at Outpost** — you must run green puzzles (e.g. [[Harbor]], [[Ferry Terminal]]) to climb the ladder. Most puzzles reset on a ~30 minute timer; Oil Rig puzzles reset on ~65 minutes.

**Blueprint Fragments:** Since Oct/Nov 2025, [[Workbench]] Tier 2 needs 5 Basic Blueprint Fragments and Tier 3 needs 5 Advanced Blueprint Fragments. Basic fragments drop from blue-tier puzzles ([[Train Yard]] 3, [[Power Plant]] 3, [[Water Treatment Plant]] 3, [[Airfield]] 2, [[Arctic Research Base]] 2, [[Harbor]] 1+1, [[Ferry Terminal]] 1); Advanced fragments drop from red-tier monuments ([[Launch Site]] 2, [[Missile Silo]] 2, [[Military Tunnels]] 2).

## Tier table — all monuments

| Monument | Tier | Keycard | Radiation (med/max) | Scientists | Recyclers | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[Launch Site]] | 3 (Large) | Green + Red, 2 fuses | 11 / 52 | 8 + [[Bradley APC]] | 1 | this folder |
| [[Large Oil Rig]] | 2/3 (Offshore) | Green, Blue, Red + fuse | none | 27 (+12 heavies) | 0 | this folder |
| [[Small Oil Rig]] | 2/3 (Offshore) | Blue + Red + fuse | none | 15 (+6 heavies) | 0 | this folder |
| [[Missile Silo]] | 2/3 (Medium) | Red | 26 / 81 | 27 | 0 | this folder |
| [[Military Tunnels]] | 3 (Large) | Green, Blue, Red + fuse | 11 / 26 | 33 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Underwater Labs]] | 1/2/3 (Offshore) | Green/Blue/Red mixes | 0 / 52 | ~4-6 dwellers | 0 | this folder |
| [[Power Plant]] | 3 (Large) | Green + Blue + fuse | 0 / 52 | 0 | 3 | this folder |
| [[Airfield]] | 2/3 (Large) | Green + Blue + 2 fuses | 11 / 11 | 3 | 2 | this folder |
| [[Train Yard]] | 2 (Large) | Green + Blue + 2 fuses | 11 / 26 | 4 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Water Treatment Plant]] | 2 (Large) | Blue + fuse | 0 / 26 | 0 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Giant Excavator Pit]] | 2 (Large) | none (NPC-guarded) | 11 / 11 | 18 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Arctic Research Base]] | 1/2/3 (Medium) | Blue ×2 | 3 / 11 | 10 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Harbor]] (Large + Small) | 1/2 (Oceanside) | Green + fuse | none | 0 | 1 each | this folder |
| [[Ferry Terminal]] | 1/2 (Oceanside) | Green + fuse | none | 0 | 1 | this folder |
| [[Deep Sea Monuments]] (Floating City, Ghost Ships, Tropical Islands) | 3 (event biome, Feb 2026) | none / locked crates | biome rad spikes on reset | ship scientists | 3 (Floating City, safezone) | this folder |
| [[Abandoned Military Base]] | 2 (Medium, desert) | none (NPC) | none | yes | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[The Dome]] | 1 (Medium) | new puzzle (2026 reshuffle) | low | 0 | 0 | small-monuments |
| [[Satellite Dish]] | 1 (Medium) | none | low | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Sewer Branch]] | 1 (Medium) | none | low | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Junkyard]] | 1 (Small) | none | none | 0 | 1 + shredder | small-monuments |
| [[Radtown]] | 1 (Roadside, returned Oct 2024) | new puzzle (2026 reshuffle) | yes | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Jungle Ziggurat]] | 1 (jungle, May 2025) | none | none | crocodiles/tigers | 0 | small-monuments |
| [[Jungle Ruins]] | 0/1 (jungle) | none | none | predators | 0 | small-monuments |
| [[Lighthouse]] | 0 (Oceanside) | none | none | 0 | 0 | small-monuments |
| [[Oxum's Gas Station]] | 0 (Roadside) | none | none | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Abandoned Supermarket]] | 0 (Roadside) | none | none | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Mining Outpost]] | 0 (Roadside) | none | none | 0 | 1 | small-monuments |
| [[Quarries]] (Stone/Sulfur/HQM) | 0 | none | none | 0 | 0 | small-monuments |

| [[Fishing Village]] / [[Stables]] | Safe zone | — | none | — | — | small-monuments |

## Recycler economics (since May 2024)

- **Safe-zone recyclers** (Outpost, Bandit Camp, Floating City): 8-second cycle, **80% yield**.
- **Monument ("Radtown") recyclers**: 5-second cycle, **120% yield** — monument recyclers are strictly better if you can hold the spot. See [[Recycler]].

## Run-planning cheat sheet

- **Fresh wipe, no cards:** [[Harbor]] / [[Ferry Terminal]] green puzzles (fuse + Green Keycard) → Blue Keycard + Basic Blueprint Fragment each.
- **Blue card in hand:** [[Train Yard]], [[Power Plant]], [[Water Treatment Plant]], [[Airfield]], [[Arctic Research Base]] → Red Keycard + Basic Fragments (T2 workbench fuel).
- **Red card in hand:** [[Launch Site]], [[Military Tunnels]], [[Missile Silo]], [[Oil Rig]]s → elite crates + Advanced Fragments (T3 fuel).
- **Pure scrap:** [[Giant Excavator Pit]] (resources), Junkyard heli shredding (200-500 scrap per heli), barrel runs along roads/rivers.

pages.title: Safe Zones
pages.body:
# Safe Zones

Overview of Rust's NPC-protected safe-zone monuments and the rules that govern them. The individual pages: [[Outpost]], [[Bandit Camp]], [[Fishing Villages]] (Large + small), and [[Ranch and Large Barn]] (stables). Everything here was re-verified against rusthelp.com in June 2026.

## The safe-zone list

| Safe zone | What it's for | Recyclers | Gambling | Vehicles sold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[Outpost]] | Vending (components, weapons, building), recycling, research, repair, drone market | 3 (safe-zone type) | 1 blackjack machine | None |
| [[Bandit Camp]] | Black-market weapons, **keycards**, helicopters (Air Wolf), casino | 2 (safe-zone type) | Wheel, 3 slots, 5 poker tables | [[Minicopter]] 750, Scrap Heli 1,250, [[Attack Helicopter]] 2,250 scrap |
| [[Fishing Villages]] | Boats, subs, diving gear, fishing, fish-for-scrap | None | None | Rowboat ~200, [[RHIB]] ~400, subs 200/300, kayak 50, DPV 200 scrap |
| [[Ranch and Large Barn]] | Horse saddles/armor, flower trade | None | None | (Horse tack, not vehicles) |

On some maps Outpost and Bandit Camp generate as a single **combined compound** — all services in one place.

## Safe zone rules

- Holding a weapon out, attacking, or looting another player flags you **hostile** and the NPC sentry turrets / guards open fire. Hostile status lasts ~30 minutes (timer shows bottom-right of screen).
- You **cannot loot** other players' bodies/bags inside the zone; stealing marks you hostile.
- **Sleeping inside a safe zone is not safe storage** — sleepers in Outpost/Bandit are killed/despawned by the zone after a while; items in your inventory while AFK there are not protected forever. Don't log out in one with loot.
- No building inside the no-build radius (Outpost's no-build area is ~125,663 m²; Bandit's ~70,685 m²).
- Patrol Helicopter will not attack inside, and crash/Chinook events do not occur there.

## Recycler split (May 2024 — important)

Since the May 2024 update there are two recycler types:

| Type | Where | Cycle speed | Yield |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Safe-zone recycler** | Outpost, Bandit Camp | 8 s per item | **80%** of components |
| **Monument ("Radtown") recycler** | Every other monument (Lighthouse, Supermarket, Oxum's, Mining Outpost, [[The Dome]], [[Sewer Branch]], [[Satellite Dish]], [[Junkyard]], [[Radtown]], etc.) | 5 s per item | **120%** of components |

**Takeaway:** recycle at open-world monuments when you can fight for it — 50% more yield and faster — and only use safe-zone recyclers when you can't afford the risk.

## Drone marketplace

Both [[Outpost]] and [[Bandit Camp]] have a **Marketplace terminal**: browse every player vending machine on the map and have items delivered by drone for a small delivery fee added to the listed price. Lets you buy from player shops without travelling.

## Dynamic vendor pricing (Jul 2024)

NPC vending machine prices **float with server demand**: every 6 hours an item that sold below average drops 5% (floor: 50% of base price); an item that sold above average rises 10% (ceiling: 200% of base). All prices on the monument pages are **base prices** — expect drift, especially on popular items (keycards, boats, low grade).

## Keycards moved (2026)

The keycard vendor ("Scrap 4 Sale") now lives at **[[Bandit Camp]]**: [[Green Keycard]] 15 scrap, [[Blue Keycard]] 40 scrap, [[Red Keycard]] 80 scrap (base prices). [[Outpost]] **no longer sells the Blue Keycard** — this changed with the 2025/2026 monument reshuffle. Note you can also *earn* blue cards free from the new green-tier puzzles at [[The Dome]], [[Satellite Dish]], [[Sewer Branch]] and [[Radtown]].

## Related

- The roaming shop-on-wheels: [[Travelling Vendor]]
- Monument recyclers + loot timers: each monument page
- The new Floating Cities (Feb 2026) also contain NPC vendors and a casino, but they are Deep Sea event content, not permanent safe zones — see [[Deep Sea]].

pages.title: Satellite Dish
pages.body:
# Satellite Dish

A medium open-world monument: two large dish antennas, an unfinished dish on a concrete foundation, and a small control building. Low radiation (median level 3, peaks ~11 near the puzzle interior — a [[Hazmat Suit]] or basic gear handles it). One of the four classic **green-card puzzle monuments** ([[The Dome]], [[Sewer Branch]], [[Radtown]] being the others) and a staple fresh-spawn run.

## Loot & facilities

| Thing | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Normal crates | 9 | 7 spawn regularly (tiers 1–3), +2 behind the puzzle door |
| Military crates | variable | 0 in tier-1 spots, mixed in tiers 2–3 |
| Barrels | 18 | blue/yellow loot barrels + oil barrels |
| Recycler | 1 | **Radtown type: 5 s/item, 120% yield** — see [[Safe Zones]]. Inside the unfinished-dish foundation. |
| Radiation | Median 3 / max 11 | Light — bring some clothing |

## Green-card puzzle

Bring **1 [[Electric Fuse]]** and **1 [[Green Keycard]]**:

1. Enter the control building, insert the fuse in the fuse box.
2. Flip the power switch to energise the circuit.
3. Swipe the green card on the reader to open the locked door.

**Reward (resets ~30 min):** **1 [[Blue Keycard]]**, **1 Basic [[Blueprint Fragment]]**, 2 normal crates, plus a **Motorbike** and 2 road signs (vehicle-parts loot). This is one of the cheapest ways to convert a green card into a blue card without buying one at [[Bandit Camp]]. (rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: 1 fuse + 1 green card, **1 switch**.)

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes — the easiest green run in the game and a staple fresh-spawn stop. No scientists, rad max 11, 1 switch, and the reward is a guaranteed blue card + fragment + a free Motorbike to ride out on. Run it the moment you have a green card and a fuse.

## Returning-player tips

- The Motorbike spawn (post-2024 vehicle reshuffle) makes a green-card run here double as free transport.
- Recycle your road-run components at the 120%-yield recycler here rather than at [[Outpost]].
- No scientists guard it — the danger is other players, not NPCs. Good solo/duo run.

Related: [[Keycards]], [[Blueprint Fragments]], [[The Dome]], [[Sewer Branch]], [[Radtown]].

pages.title: Sewer Branch
pages.body:
# Sewer Branch

A compact industrial monument built around a sewer/water-treatment outflow, with two recyclers and a green-card puzzle. Light radiation (median 3, max ~11). The third of the four classic green-card puzzle monuments ([[Satellite Dish]], [[The Dome]], [[Radtown]]).

## Loot & facilities

| Thing | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Normal crates | ~11 | 9 at 80% spawn + 2 medical/food variants |
| Military crates | 9 | spawn at ~20% (vs 80% for normal) — high mil-crate ceiling for a minor monument |
| Barrels | 4 | 60% blue / 40% yellow loot barrels |
| Recyclers | 2 | **Radtown type: 5 s/item, 120% yield** ([[Safe Zones]]) — two of them, rare for a minor monument |
| Radiation | Median 3 / max 11 | light gear advised |

## Green-card puzzle

Bring **1 [[Electric Fuse]]** + **1 [[Green Keycard]]**: fuse in the box, flip the switch, swipe the card.

**Reward (resets ~30 min):** **1 [[Blue Keycard]]**, **1 Basic [[Blueprint Fragment]]**, and access to the locked crate room (9 crates, 80% normal / 20% military). (rusthelp spec, Jun 2026: 1 fuse + 1 green card, **1 switch**.)

**Worth it for a solo?** Yes — the best crate count of any green run (9 puzzle crates with a 20% military share) plus **two** 120%-yield recyclers, all with no scientists. Bring a full inventory of road-run junk to recycle on-site. Top pick among the green monuments when you want loot volume, not just the blue card.

## Returning-player tips

- **Two** 120%-yield recyclers make Sewer Branch a top component-recycling stop — bring a full inventory of road-run junk.
- High military-crate share means decent component/gun-part odds for a low-radiation monument.
- Like the other green-card monuments, no scientists — only player threat.

Related: [[Keycards]], [[Blueprint Fragments]], [[Satellite Dish]], [[The Dome]], [[Radtown]].

pages.title: Small Oil Rig
pages.body:
# Small Oil Rig

The little sibling of [[Large Oil Rig]] — same loot archetype (locked crate + heavies) at roughly half the difficulty. The standard duo/trio money run once you hold a [[Red Keycard]]. No radiation (until post-hack flood), no recyclers.

## Vital stats (verified vs rusthelp.com, Jun 2026)

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Type / Tier | Offshore / Tier 2-3 |
| Radiation | none — floods with radiation 30 min after the crate hack starts |
| Scientists | 15 Oil Rig Scientists |
| Heavy scientists | 6 arrive by Chinook on hack start (25% each: M249 / Spas-12 / Minigun / Flamethrower) |
| Recyclers | none |
| Keycard spawns | 1 Green Keycard on the rig |
| CCTV | 6 cameras: DOCK, HELI, L1-L4 |
| Puzzle resets | ~65 min |
| No-build zone | 4,096 m² |

## Loot summary

- **25 crates**: 1 Locked Oilrig Crate, 1 Elite Crate, ~4 Military Crates, ~7 Normal Crates, 4 Medical/Food.
- **15 barrels** (8 oil/diesel + 7 loot).
- Puzzles:
  - **Puzzle 1** — [[Blue Keycard]] + [[Red Keycard]], survive 6 heavies → 1 Locked Crate, 1 Elite Crate, 1 Military Crate, 1 Green Keycard.
  - **Puzzle 2** — 1 [[Electric Fuse]] + button → 2 Military Crates.
  - **Puzzle 3** — [[Green Keycard]] → 3 Normal Crates.

## Run walkthrough (doable as a confident solo, comfortable as a duo)

1. Boat in on the **dock side** or climb a far leg ladder. Park your boat under the platform so the Chinook can't strafe it.
