pages.title: Airborne Update
pages.body:
# Airborne Update

**September 7, 2023** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/airborne. The defining update of late 2023: player air combat.

## Attack Helicopter
- **Cost: 2,250 scrap** at the Air Wolf vendor in [[Bandit Camp]].
- Two seats: pilot + dedicated **gunner** operating a front turret (loaded with your own guns/ammo) and side **rocket pods** (HV and incendiary rockets only).
- Pilot can also fire rockets, with worse precision than the gunner.
- Both seats can pop **flares** to break incoming homing missile locks. *(Nerf, Nov 2025: flares no longer fool homing missiles — see [[Pivot Or Die Update]].)*
- Counterable by aimed rockets, [[SAM Site]]s, and the Homing Missile Launcher below.
- Later additions: rocket-type radial menu (Jun 2025); in-flight repair and pilot-healing removed (Nov 2025).

## Parachutes
- **Craft: Tier 2 Workbench — 2 Tarp, 2 Sewing Kit, 50 Cloth.** Equips in the dedicated backpack slot.
- Deploy mid-air with Space; steer with movement keys. Wearable with full armor.
- **Degrades 20% per use**; damaged chutes fall faster and steer worse. Up to 80 HP damage on hard landings.
- SAM sites and [[Auto Turret]]s can shoot you out of the sky.
- Enables roof-drop raids from hot air balloons/helis — changed base design (roof protection matters).

## Homing Missile Launcher
- **Craft: T2 — 20 HQM, 3 Metal Pipes, 1 Tech Trash, 1 CCTV Camera.**
- **Homing Missiles: 3 Metal Pipes, 200 Gunpowder, 1 Tech Trash → 2 missiles** (cost reduced + stack to 4 in Oct 2023).
- Lock-on requires sustained line of sight; switching weapons breaks lock. The dedicated anti-air answer for ground players.

## Other changes
- **Global Networked Bases** (experimental, off by default): structures render at 1,500m instead of 300m — scout SAMs/bases from range.
- Hot Air Balloon: purchasable **armor upgrade** at Bandit Camp, cheaper fuel/repairs.
- [[Patrol Helicopter]] now auto-deploys flares; boats idle 2h then drift to shore.
- Windows 8.1 support ended Oct 28, 2023.

## Meta impact
Scrap-rich groups gained air dominance: heli rocket strafes on compounds, parachute roof-drops. SAM sites went from niche to near-mandatory for big bases, and the homing launcher became standard kit on raid-defense benches.

pages.title: Bags To Riches Update
pages.body:
# Bags To Riches Update

**February 1, 2024** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/bags-to-riches. Added the most-requested item in Rust history: backpacks.

## Backpacks
| | Small Backpack | Large Backpack |
|---|---|---|
| Slots | **12** | **28** |
| Source | Craftable: **50 Cloth + 5 Sewing Kits, T1 workbench**, 30s craft | **Military loot only** |
| Slot | Dedicated backpack slot (same slot as [[Parachute]]/shields) | Same |

- **Both drop on death** as a separate bag (3s pickup); despawn timer extends up to **2 hours** when filled with valuable items.
- Massive solo/duo QoL: farm runs, recycler runs, and raid carries all scale up.

## Metal Detector
- New tool: sweep ground, follow green/yellow indicator lights to buried loot; loot varies by terrain.
- Buffed Aug 2025: can detect weapons buried where players died (24h window, low chance).

## Other changes
- **Wooden shelter limit: 1 per player** (shelter spam nerf).
- Plant ripeness window 4 → 14 hours (later 24h in Apr 2026).
- Doors/hatches/embrasures rotatable during placement; death markers on compass; safe-zone logout warning.
- SAP/SAR animation rework began the 2024 "weapon feel" pass.
- Player remains redesigned (open/closed states show if a body bag was looted).
- Performance: ~3GB shader savings, 6–9% fewer entities.

## Meta impact
Backpacks changed loot logistics permanently — deep-roam kits, bigger sulfur runs, and "naked with a backpack" recycling runs. Large Backpacks became a standard military-crate chase item. Cross-reference: [[Inventory]] / [[Backpacks]].

pages.title: Built Different Update
pages.body:
# Built Different Update

**June 4, 2026** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/built-different. The current patch as of 2026-06-12.

## Player model overhaul
- First full rebuild of the player model in ~10 years: new skeleton/rig, realistic proportions, improved meshes/materials, expanded head + hair/beard seeds, eyelashes, better eye lighting.
- **Your race/gender seed is preserved** — you keep "your" character, just upgraded.
- All clothing re-fitted to the new rig (post-patch hotfixes cleaned up clipping). Hitboxes feel slightly different; community is still calibrating.

## New endgame gear (loot-only)
- **M16A2**: military rifle built around a **3-round burst**; excellent mid-range accuracy; **lower per-shot damage than the LR-300** to balance burst potential. End-game crates only.
- **Ballistic Armor set**: Ballistic Helmet / Vest / Leg armor (~plated-metal-tier) + **BDU Shirt/Pants** (slightly better than existing cloth-tier kit). All loot-only.

## Engine: Unity 6
- Rust upgraded to **Unity 6** plus a new opt-in custom navmesh (`-useNewNavmesh`): smarter scientist pathing, **animals can path into bases**, lower server overhead.
- New layered animation subsystem (e.g., torch in right arm while full-body locomotion continues).
- **Known issue: mice polling at 1000Hz+ cause performance problems** — lower polling rate in mouse software if the game stutters.

## Performance
- Lock-free object pooling, console command allocations eliminated, ~20 server allocation sources removed, UsePlayerUpdateJobs 3 saves 0.6ms on busy frames.
- Improved hit validation for players on moving parents (boats, balloons) — fewer "projectile invalid" kicks.

## Misc
- Industrial Decor Pack DLC (20 items); Auto Turret + Electric Furnace + BBQ now workshop-skinnable; skin viewer hand-inspection.
- **Premium Access Pass** rebrand of premium servers (no functional change); a separate paid **"Rust Premium"** battlepass-style system is slated for **late 2026**.

## Meta impact
Mostly a feel/visual patch: relearn silhouettes and head positions on the new models, chase the M16A2/Ballistic set in endgame loot, and expect NPC behavior to improve as servers enable the new navmesh.

pages.title: Common Ground Update
pages.body:
# Common Ground Update

**July 2, 2026** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/common-ground. The current patch as of 2026-07-11 (superseded the June [[Built Different Update]]). Verified against rust.facepunch.com/news, Rustafied, and rusthelp.

> **The one-line summary:** a mode-focused patch. **Softcore** gets a big shakeup (2x gather + timed raid windows), a real **clan system** lands on standard/softcore servers, and a new safe-zone **Apartment Complex** monument adds rentable rooms and player shops. **No weapon, armor, building-HP, or explosive-damage changes** — raid and base numbers carry forward unchanged from Built Different.

## Softcore mode overhaul (softcore servers only)

Both of the big gameplay levers below are **Softcore-mode defaults, not vanilla**. On standard official (vanilla) servers nothing about gather rate or raid timing changed. All are server-configurable.

- **2x resource gathering (softcore).** Trees, ores, harvestable corpses (animals), and collectibles all yield **twice** as much by default. Pushes softcore toward a lower-stress, faster-progression experience.
- **Raid windows (softcore).** By default, **structures can only be raided between 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM local server time** (same clock for everyone on that server). "Structures" = building blocks and openings: walls, floors, roofs, doors, ladder hatches. Outside that window, an active **Tool Cupboard projects raid protection over the base** and those blocks/doors cannot be damaged.
  - **Deployables and an unprotected TC stay vulnerable 24/7** — TC (if not yet protecting), turrets, boxes, external walls, and other deployables can be attacked anytime.
  - The **TC must be at least 1 hour old** before it provides raid-window protection (anti-insta-TC exploit).
  - Fully server-configurable (hours, on/off).

## Clan system (standard + softcore; disabled in hardcore)

A proper "advanced teams" layer above the 8-player team UI, built around a craftable **Clan Table**:

- Full clan UI: **member management, roles, announcements, logs, and a score section**.
- **Clan name shown on member nameplates**; dedicated **clan chat** channel + announcements.
- **Clan member locations shown on the nearby map**.
- **Disabled in Hardcore mode.** Available on standard/vanilla and softcore servers. (See also [[Clans and Groups]] / [[Team System]] for how a group operates beyond the team cap.)

## Apartment Complex (new safe-zone monument)

A new **safe-zone** monument with rentable, post-wipe living space and a player-driven marketplace:

- **Rentable rooms** in three sizes with an upfront scrap fee + ongoing daily scrap rent (approx., per Rustafied): **small ~25 scrap + ~10/day, medium ~150 + ~50/day, large ~350 + ~100/day**. Miss rent and you get evicted.
- Rooms come furnished: **storage, bed, phone, furnace, and a Tier-1 workbench** — a rentable mini-base inside a safe zone.
- **Rentable shops / marketplace stalls:** buy a storefront (non-refundable upfront scrap + per-real-hour rent, ~12h minimum at open). Abandoned/taken-over shops: takeover available after ~6h at escalating (2x/3x/4x) multipliers; leftover items linger ~24h.
- **Master key** exists somewhere on the map (~1000 scrap value) — opens an occupied room or a shop's inventory for **~5 minutes**. A **basement guard** gives hints toward room locations. Expect safe-zone shenanigans (baiting, master-key runs).

## Animation improvements

- **New sprint animations for rifles** (two-handed projectile weapons) — sprinting while holding a rifle looks/handles far less robotic.
- The **torch one-hand hold animation was extended to the Hatchet** (carry a light source in one hand while the other tool animates).
- General responsiveness/polish continuing the Built Different player-model rework.

## Balance / numbers

- **No weapon, armor, building-HP, or explosive-damage rebalance.** Verified: [[Raid Costs]] (walls/doors/deployables sulfur) are **unchanged** by this patch — 1 C4 = [[Sheet Metal Door]] (2,200 sulfur), 2 C4 = [[Stone Wall]] (4,400), etc. still hold.

## Hotfixes

Common Ground shipped with follow-up hotfixes over the first week (bug/crash/clipping and clan/apartment edge-case fixes typical of a monument + systems patch). No hotfix altered raid costs or weapon/armor stats. (If a specific hotfix changes a number, log it here and bump `updated:`.)

## Meta impact

- **Vanilla solo/duo/trio players:** almost nothing changes day-to-day — same guns, same armor kit, same raid math. The clan system is the only cross-mode addition you'll touch, and the Apartment Complex is a new safe-zone loot/econ stop.
- **If you play softcore:** the game is meaningfully different — 2x gather makes progression fast, and **timed raid windows mean your base is only breakable 6-9 PM local** (huge for offline-raid anxiety), so build/defend around that window and don't leave deployables or a fresh TC exposed.
- Full "what's strong now" snapshot: [[Current Meta — Common Ground (July 2026)]].

**Related:** [[Rust Update History]] · [[Built Different Update]] · [[Raid Costs]] · [[Farming Basics]] · [[Server Types]] · [[Clans and Groups]] · [[Rust Companion App (Web)]]

pages.title: Crafting Update
pages.body:
# Crafting Update

**March 6, 2025** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/crafting-update. Farming, cooking, and gear customization became real subsystems. Premium Servers followed March 13.

## Cooking & food
- **Cooking Workbench**: new deployable with exclusive recipes and stat-boosting foods; **8 pie varieties** with unique buffs (e.g., Big Cat Pie later grants Hunter Vision). Wheat + bread added as crops.
- **Food spoilage**: raw meat spoils in **6 hours**, cooked in **24 hours** — **paused inside powered fridges**. (Produce/eggs spoil too as of Jun 2025; spoiled produce has a 48h fridge timer.) Fridges and electricity are now part of food logistics.
- New cooling/warming teas for biome protection; Advanced/Pure tea variants added Jun 2025.

## Animals & farming
- **Chicken Coop**: hatch and raise chickens (hunger/thirst/love/sunlight stats) for eggs/meat. Resized to 1 foundation in May 2025.
- **Bees**: natural hives on oak trees, deployable player hives (honey production), and **Bee Grenades** as a weapon (also catapult-launchable). Clothing mitigates bee damage (Apr 2025).
- Triangle planters (4 seeds), cosmetic flowers, plant pots.

## Armor slots (gear customization)
- Player-crafted armor rolls **0–3 random insert slots**; inserts give bonuses (protection, mobility, etc.).
- **Crafting Quality Potion** improves high-slot odds; chances rebalanced Jun 2025. Loot armor doesn't roll slots — crafting your kit matters again.

## Industrial/automation
- **Engineering Workbench** (Level 1): dedicated bench for water/electrical/industrial unlocks.
- **Hopper**: attachment for large boxes/barrels that **auto-collects dropped items and harvests corpses in a radius** — farm-base and sulfur-furnace QoL.

## QoL & tech
- **Item ownership**: items track who crafted them.
- **Drones: range 300 → 600m, HP 100 → 200.** 40+ items craft faster.
- Train tunnels moved closer to the surface; graphics presets overhauled; build-privilege calc 50ms → "several ms" in big bases.

## Premium Servers (March 13)
- Opt-in server flag requiring a **$15+ Steam inventory value** to join — friction against throwaway cheat accounts. Reported **4x fewer cheater encounters** by April 2025. Premium status shows on avatars.

## Meta impact
Food went from afterthought to subsystem: tea/pie buff stacking is part of high-end PvP prep, fridge+electricity is standard base infrastructure, and armor-slot crafting created a gear-quality grind beyond blueprints.

pages.title: Deep Sea Update
pages.body:
# Deep Sea Update

**July 6, 2023** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/deep-sea. Not to be confused with the **Deep Sea zone** added by the Feb 2026 [[Naval Update]].

## Headline features

### Tugboat
- Drivable slow boat that spawns at [[Harbor]] monuments (1–2 per harbor).
- **Buildable/claimable interior**: place doors, locks, and deployables inside — a mobile mini-base. (Electrical IO on boats didn't work until the Mar 2026 Shipshape patch.)
- Damageable, hammer-repairable, sinks permanently if destroyed. Became the iconic solo/nomad playstyle.
- Later QoL: tugboat TC friend-list auth (Jun 2025), horn (Aug 2025).

### Water system overhaul
Two years of work: real ocean waves rolling toward shore, improved underwater camera/visuals. Foundation for everything naval that came after (DPV in 2024, player boats in 2026).

### Ferry Terminal
New coastal monument: standard loot, a [[Recycler]], and subway/tunnel connection. Got a keycard puzzle later in the Oct 2025 [[Meta Shift Update]] loot reshuffle.

## Smaller changes
- Spray cans no longer lose condition when reskinning.
- Combat knife quickly unties underwater crates.
- Shader backend overhaul (less memory).

## Why it mattered
First step of Facepunch's multi-year ocean push: Tugboat (2023) → harbor/cargo rework (Apr 2024, [[Waves Of Change Update]]) → DPV + dive sites (Oct 2024, [[World Update 2.0]]) → full [[Naval Update]] (2026).

pages.title: Jungle Update
pages.body:
# Jungle Update

**May 1, 2025** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/jungle-update. The **first new biome since procedural generation launched**.

## Jungle biome
- Spawns in **tier 0** (new-player coastal zones); flatter terrain, higher river density, very thick foliage.
- Climbable **kapok trees** with **vine swinging** between branches (vines must be thrown back to teammates — co-op traversal).
- Jun 2025 polish: players no longer spawn directly in jungle; wild hemp made visible; monument distribution fixed.

## New wildlife
| Animal | Behavior |
|---|---|
| **Tiger** | Deadliest animal; stalks slowly, strikes when sure of the kill; 3 in-game tells when you're being stalked |
| **Panther** | Rare black tiger variant |
| **Crocodile** | Tankiest; territorial "mutual respect" behavior near water |
| **Snake** | Stealth + **poison** (slows movement); hiss warning — jump after the hiss to dodge; drops Snake Venom for crafting |

(Wolves had already been overhauled into pack hunters in Nov–Dec 2024.)

## New weapons
- **Boomerang**: early throwable that returns after each throw; melee backup.
- **Blowpipe**: silent early-game ranged weapon with 4 darts — Wood (damage), Scatter (short-range spread), **Incapacitate** (slow + vision blur; nerfed to 4s in Jun 2025), **Radiation** (stacking rads).

## Monuments
- **Ziggurat**: large weathered stone pyramid with secrets.
- **Jungle Ruins**: small early-game ruins with low-tier loot.

## Big balance change: armor cap
- **Explosive protection capped at 75%** (stacked kits could previously hit 93%) — no more facetanking rockets. Raid defense changed game-wide, not just in jungle.

## Other
- Rivers across ALL biomes: longer, wider, deeper — must swim across.
- **Hunter Vision** buff (Big Cat Pie, 15 min): see animal scent trails.
- Vending machines act as fridges; Jungle Pack DLC (20 items, Cocoknight wood armor, bamboo storage).
- Server occlusion (anti-wallhack) enabled by default; Twitch drops through May 28.

## Meta impact
Jungle is the new early-game: dense cover makes bow/blowpipe ambushes strong and visibility terrible — bases inside jungle are hard to spot but animal pressure is constant. The 75% explosive cap is the bigger long-term meta change for raid defense.

pages.title: Lighting The Way Update
pages.body:
# Lighting The Way Update

**March 7, 2024** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/lighting-the-way.

## Tutorial Island
- New-player onboarding: a safe, instanced island with NPC-guided missions teaching movement, harvesting, crafting, building, and combat.
- Takes "less than 30 minutes" for experienced players; fully skippable. First structured onboarding in Rust's history — relevant if Josia brings new friends in.

## Nightlight (anti-gamma night)
- Shader-based night vision: a small lit radius around the player while distance stays dark.
- Purpose-built to kill **gamma cheating** — cranking monitor gamma no longer turns night into day. Night is now a real stealth window for everyone equally.

## Vendor + store UI
- Vending/NPC vendor UI redesigned (clear prices + stock); item store got 3D skin previews.

## Balance and QoL
- **Attack Helicopter flares limited to one use per 30 seconds** (see [[Airborne Update]]).
- Binoculars gained a **rangefinder**.
- Metal Detectors blocked in safe zones.
- Default nudity setting now pixelated.
- Shader memory cut ~30%; Hapis Island + Observer Island retired from officials.
- Easter event (Mar 21): egg hunts with prizes up to an M249.

## Meta impact
Night raids/roams got stronger because defenders can no longer gamma-watch; flashlights, NVG, and flares matter again.

pages.title: Livestock and Animal Breeding
pages.body:
# Livestock and Animal Breeding

> **STATUS: UNRELEASED / ROADMAPPED.** Cows, sheep, the animal trough, and breeding are **NOT in Rust yet** as of the [[Built Different Update]] (June 4 2026). This page documents what Facepunch has **announced and teased** in the 2026 roadmap so a returning/active player knows what's coming and isn't confused about what's live. The only domesticated animals you can actually keep today are [[Chicken Coop|chickens]] and [[Bees|bees]] from the [[Crafting Update]].

This is the headline gameplay item on the [[Rust 2026 Roadmap]]: a full **livestock + breeding** layer that turns Rust's animal life from "things you hunt" into "things you raise."

## Facepunch's exact framing

From the **"Surviving 12 Years"** roadmap post (Jan 1 2026): they will add **"new animals, cows and sheep, for example, alongside a proper animal breeding system."** Goal stated: create **"interesting gameplay opportunities and add more depth to the world beyond simple hunting."** PCGamesN's coverage adds that players should expect **large-scale farming opportunities** as a result.

Everything below the next line is **described/teased detail, not finalized mechanics.**

---

## Planned animals & products (teased)

| Animal | Domesticated via | Yields | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cow** | New **animal trough** (feeding station) | **Milk**, **high-quality leather** | New leather tier above wolf/bear; milk likely feeds into [[Cooking Workbench]] recipes |
| **Sheep** | Animal trough | **Wool** | Wool → high-tier clothing + **rugs** (new craftables) |
| (Decorative animals) | — | Cosmetic | "Decorative animals" mentioned for base/world flavor |

> These products (milk, wool, high-quality leather) are **new resources** that don't exist in the game today. Numbers (yields, growth timers, feed cost) are **unannounced** — do not quote any.

---

## Planned mechanics (teased, unconfirmed)

- **Animal trough** — a deployable feeding/water station that domesticates and sustains livestock. This is the keystone new deployable.
- **Breeding system** — pair animals and raise offspring instead of relying only on wild spawns. "Proper breeding" implies generational raising, not just a spawn timer.
- **Improved animal AI** — broader AI pass (builds on the [[Jungle Update]] predators and the Nov 2024 wolf-AI overhaul that introduced real stalking behavior).
- **Dung / fertilizer farming** — expanded dung loop feeding the existing [[Farming|planter/horse-dung]] system as fertilizer; ties livestock back into crop yields.
- **Large-scale farming** — the combined intent is a self-sustaining farm base (crops + livestock + bees + chickens), reducing reliance on hunting and monument runs for food/leather/cloth.

---

## How it fits the existing farming pillar

Rust already has a domestic-farming spine that this extends:

| Live today | Source update | Roadmapped addition |
|---|---|---|
| [[Chicken Coop]] (eggs) | [[Crafting Update]] (Mar 2025) | Cows, sheep |
| [[Bees]] + bee grenades | [[Crafting Update]] | Animal trough |
| [[Cooking Workbench]] + 8 buff pies | [[Crafting Update]] | Milk → new recipes |
| Planters + horse dung fertilizer | base game / [[Crafting Update]] | Expanded dung farming |
| Food spoilage + powered fridges | [[Crafting Update]] | Milk/wool storage implications |

So livestock isn't a one-off — it's the **capstone of the farming-base playstyle** Facepunch has been building since the [[Crafting Update]].

---

## Timing

Targeted for the **back half of 2026 (around Q4)** per ecosystem-roadmap coverage. **Not a promise** — Facepunch explicitly treats the roadmap as a direction of travel, and recent items have slipped (the [[Naval Update]] slid from Dec 2025 to Feb 2026). **Re-check the latest first-Thursday news post** to see if cows/sheep have actually dropped before treating any of this as live.

## What to do as a returning player right now

You **can't** raise cows or sheep yet. To prep for the playstyle when it lands:
- Get comfortable with the live [[Chicken Coop]] + [[Bees]] + [[Cooking Workbench]] loop.
- Keep horses (the Feb 2025 horse overhaul gave them saddlebags + dung farming) — dung farming is the likely on-ramp to the fertilizer side of livestock.
- Watch the first-Thursday posts mid-to-late 2026.

## Related

- [[Rust 2026 Roadmap]] — parent page, all forward-looking items
- [[Crafting Update]] — the farming foundation (chickens, bees, cooking)
- [[Farming]] — current crop/planter mechanics
- [[Rust Premium Battle Pass]] — the other big 2026 unknown

## Sources

- rust.facepunch.com/news — **"Surviving 12 Years"** (Jan 1 2026)
- PCGamesN — "expanded ecosystem, breeding, and maybe a battle pass"
- Supercraft Host / Sportskeeda — Rust 2026 ecosystem roadmap coverage (cows milk/leather, sheep wool/rugs, trough, dung)

pages.title: Meta Madness Update
pages.body:
# Meta Madness Update

**May 2, 2024** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/meta-madness. The combat/economy rebalance that still shapes the modern game. (Recoil itself was reworked back in 2022's "Combat Update" — this patch tuned aimcone on top of that.)

## Aimcone overhaul
- Movement accuracy penalty now **blends in gradually over the first ~4 shots** instead of applying instantly — tap-firing while strafing is viable; sustained moving spray still punished.

## Recycler split (huge for the loot economy)
| Location | Cycle time | Yield |
|---|---|---|
| **Safe zone recyclers** ([[Outpost]], [[Bandit Camp]]) | 8 seconds | **80%** of old yield |
| **Monument recyclers** | 5 seconds | **120%** of old yield |

AFK-recycling at Outpost was nerfed; risky monument recycling pays more. See [[Recycler]].

## Weapons
- **LR-300 buffed** (damage falloff, velocity, recoil) — explicitly positioned "best in class AR."
- Custom SMG: 30-round mag; Burst Module refire 3x → 2x firerate; Holosight slimmer; muzzle brake/boost penalties reduced.

## Economy
- **HV ammo gunpowder cost 6x → 2x**; incendiary rockets much cheaper and stronger; torpedo craft 3 → 5; drones no longer need tech trash.
- **Tech tree tax introduced: +10% scrap at WB2, +20% at WB3** (research table unchanged). *(Removed Nov 2025 — see [[Pivot Or Die Update]].)*

## Building/PvP
- Large external gates/walls: **1.5s placement delay** (no more instant combat-walling).
- Wooden barricades doubled in size, still instant.
- Door controllers deployable like code locks; **TC can authorize other players directly**.
- [[Launch Site]] main building: guaranteed 23 crates with dedicated respawns.
- [[Bradley APC]] scientists spawn in stages (2 at 80% HP, +4 at 60%, +6 at 40%).

## Technical
- Harmony 1.2 → 2.3 (broke old server mods); impact effects pre-warmed (no more first-fight stutter); procedural maps auto-uploaded for faster first join.

## Meta impact
This is why gunfights feel different from 2023: strafing tap-fire is back, the LR-300 became the go-to T3 rifle for years, and scrap farming moved to contested monument recyclers.

pages.title: Meta Shift Update
pages.body:
# Meta Shift Update

**October 2, 2025** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/meta-shift. The progression overhaul that (with its November follow-up [[Pivot Or Die Update|Pivot Or Die]]) defines the current game loop.

## Blueprint Fragments
- **Workbench Tier 2 requires 5 Basic Blueprint Fragments; Tier 3 requires 5 Advanced Fragments** in addition to normal costs.
- Fragments come from **monument loot, crates, and airdrops** — you cannot tech up by farming scrap at base; you must contest monuments.
- Intent: slow week-one progression, force map presence, create PvP. Reception was loudly mixed (PC Gamer: "controversial"; solos felt squeezed). Facepunch kept the system and rebalanced costs in November rather than reverting.

## Monument loot reshuffle
- Loot tables repositioned across nearly **all monuments** — first reshuffle in 5+ years; old "best crate" knowledge is stale.
- **New puzzle rooms** at [[The Dome]], [[Ferry Terminal]], and [[Radtown]].
- **[[Nuclear Missile Silo]] upgraded from blue to red keycard** with **3 additional elite crates** — now a true endgame monument.

## Crosshair customization
Full custom crosshairs: style, color, dot size, gap, outline, visibility, import/export via shareable codes.

## Balance/QoL
- Wooden barricade stack cut again 5 → **3**, HP −20% (anti-barricade-spam continued).
- **Catapult range +30%, reload −50%**; battering ram cheaper — siege buffs (see [[Primitive Update]]).
- **Spike Trap** (80 wood); shore crates wash up on spawn beaches; drones get a 1-stack storage slot; SAMs/turrets target player drones; mission rewards buffed; chainsaw always starts.

## November follow-up: see [[Pivot Or Die Update]]
Full blueprint wipe + research costs slashed (15/30/60/120 scrap) + workbench scrap-tax removed. Fragments remain in the game as of June 2026.

## Meta impact (current loop as of 2026)
Wipe day: farm scrap for WB1 → hit monuments/airdrops for **Basic fragments** → WB2 → contest bigger monuments for **Advanced fragments** → WB3. Research itself is cheap now — the bottleneck is fragments, i.e., monument control.

pages.title: Naval Update
pages.body:
# Naval Update

**February 5, 2026** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/naval. The biggest update of the 2023–2026 era; delayed from December 2025 because "we took on too much." Polished by **Shipshape** (March 5, 2026).

## Player-built boats
- **Boat Building Station** placed in water; build modular vessels from hull blocks plus deployable parts: **steering wheels/helms (code-lockable), sails, engines (low-grade fuel), anchors, cannons (cannonball ammo), ramps, planks**.
- Engine/sail count and placement affect handling and speed — bad builds are unseaworthy.
- Shipshape additions: **electricity, industrial, and water IO work on boats**; wallpaper; deployable snapping; blocks rotatable/demolishable anytime in edit mode; decay delay 12 → 24h (duration 18 → 12h); cannon hits slow targets to 30% speed; aim sway when firing on the move.

## Deep Sea zone
- High-risk offshore region that **opens and closes intermittently like a world event** (notification sound on open).
- **No building**, loot is first-come-first-served; needs a strong vessel (player ship or PT Boat — **RHIBs banned** since March).
- March rework: loot respawns slowly (~70% initial fill), random spawn locations, static boat-building stations on islands with docking magnets. Loot quantities trimmed again in May 2026.

## New locations
- **Tropical Islands**: semi-procedural micro-islands — white sand, palms, ore deposits, ancient ruins.
- **Ghost Ships**: stationary monument-vessels in the deep sea, guarded by scientists, holding locked crates.
- **Floating Cities**: 4 variants with NPC vendors, farming barges, recyclers, workbenches, research tables, and the **Deep Deck Casino**.

## Vessels & NPCs
- **PT Boat**: slow, fuel-hungry military boat with **two .50-cal turrets**.
- RHIB refresh (new model, storage, compass + map displays); scientist boat patrols at Large [[Oil Rig]].
- **Naval scientists** (oil rigs, ghost ships, islands): **don't see through walls** — they track noise and last-seen position, so flanking works. March tuning: can't see through smoke, more misses, less damage, hazmat protection 5%→30%.

## Missions & misc
- 5 naval missions with optional bonus objectives; Artist DLC pack (paintball gun, paintable frames/easel); SKS opened to workshop skins.
- Huge server perf pass: ovens 18ms → 0.25ms, industrial 20ms → 3ms, buoyancy 4x faster, junkpile spawn attempts 25,000 → 3,019.

## Meta impact
The ocean is now a full progression lane: build a ship, raid ghost ships, time Deep Sea openings for elite loot, and fight cannon-vs-cannon naval battles. Tugboat-style sea-nomad play scaled up into actual base-ships — and offshore loot competes with Oil Rig as the "organized small group" money-maker.

pages.title: Pivot Or Die Update
pages.body:
# Pivot Or Die Update

**November 6, 2025** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/pivot-or-die. Doubled down on the [[Meta Shift Update]] progression rework instead of reverting it.

## Progression changes
- **Full blueprint wipe** for all players (rare — Facepunch said map+BP wipes like this "might become a regular thing").
- **Research costs slashed**: Common **15** scrap (was 20), Uncommon **30** (was 75), Rare **60** (was 125), Very Rare **120** (was 500).
- **Scrap crafting cost removed from workbenches** (the +10%/+20% tech-tree tax from May 2024 is gone).
- **Blueprint Fragments kept** — the WB2/WB3 fragment gates stayed. Net effect: getting BPs is cheap, getting *workbenches* requires monument play.
- Community reception: PC Gamer called it "a nightmare for solo survivors" at launch; balance settled over the following months.

## New items / QoL
- **Mini Fridge**: 18 slots, 3 power, early unlock (pairs with food spoilage from the [[Crafting Update]]).
- **Box sorting** via Storage Adaptors: alphabetical, condition, count, category, or snapshot sorting.
- Elevators 3 → 5 m/s with power inputs on all floors.

## Balance
- **Attack/patrol helicopter nerfs: flares no longer spoof homing missiles; no in-flight repair; no healing while piloting.** Mini + scrap heli gained flare launchers. (See [[Airborne Update]].)
- Monument puzzle anti-camping: radiation 10 min before reset; timers start after looting; puzzles reset after 5 min of absence.
- Horses healable with med syringes (+12.6 km/h for 4s).
- **Blue Keycard removed from Outpost** (must be found/looted now); M4 Shotgun back in hackable crates; L96 spawn chance lowered; DPV sold at Fishing Village.

## Performance
UI per-frame cost 1.40ms → 0.17ms; parallelized server occlusion; arcade machine +20–30 FPS.

## Why it matters
This patch (plus October) is the single biggest "things are different now" item for a returning 2023 player: the scrap-grind progression you remember is gone — replaced by cheap research gated behind **fragment hunting at monuments**, with a fresh BP grind every wipe that wipes blueprints.

pages.title: Primitive Update
pages.body:
# Primitive Update

**February 6, 2025** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/primitive. Medieval warfare: siege weapons, shields, a horse overhaul, and a limited-tech gamemode.

## Siege weapons (craftable, deployable, horse-towable vehicles)
| Weapon | Role |
|---|---|
| **Catapult** | Lobs scattershot, firebombs, or propane explosive bombs over walls; AoE on impact. Range +30% and reload −50% in Oct 2025. Can also launch **Bee Bombs** (Jun 2025). |
| **Ballista** | Long-range wheeled crossbow; bolts: pitchfork, piercer, hammerhead, incendiary. |
| **Battering Ram** | Fuel-powered vehicle that smashes **wood/stone** structures (not metal+). Sheet metal cost reduced Oct 2025. |
| **Siege Tower** | Three-level rolling tower with drawbridges — go over walls instead of through. |

A sulfur-free (but slow and visible) raid path — especially relevant for online raids and primitive servers. See [[Raiding]].

## Shields
- Equip in the **backpack slot** with any one-handed weapon; absorb damage by type; hold up ~4 seconds before lowering.
- Hitbox tuned Apr 2026 (smaller idle, larger held). Usable on weapon racks.

## Horse overhaul
- Horses got better terrain traversal, **swimming**, tree avoidance, and **tow siege weapons**; CTRL = skid/tight turns at gallop. Server cost "massively improved."
- Nov 2025: medical syringes heal horses (+12.6 km/h burst for 4s).

## 4-Shot Mini Crossbow
Rotating-barrel early-game weapon: 4 shots, lower damage/range than the standard crossbow.

## Primitive gamemode (separate servers)
- Tech capped to early game: bows/spears/melee only, no high-tech items or late-game monuments; **sulfur spawns −50%, tech tree costs doubled**.

## Other
- Medieval Pack DLC (knight armor, castle doors, medieval barricade).
- Sleeping bags pickupable inside TC range; phone names to 30 chars; server profiler overhead cut ~97% (17MB → 0.5MB json/player).

## Meta impact
On vanilla, siege weapons are situational raid/defense tools (catapult firebomb spam, battering-ram door pressure on stone bases); shields gave early-game fighters a real defensive option against bows/melee.

pages.title: Road Renegades Update
pages.body:
# Road Renegades Update

**July 4, 2024** — official post: rust.facepunch.com/news/road-renegades. Two-wheel vehicles, player capture, and the Travelling Vendor.

## Bikes
- **Motorbike**: fast, nimble, runs on low-grade fuel, repaired with metal fragments. **Sidecar variant** lets a passenger shoot.
- **Pedal Bike**: silent, no fuel — drains food/water instead. **Trike variant** carries a gunner.
- Sprint mode gives a temporary speed boost; bunnyhopping added Oct 2025 (1 hop/3s, 10% stamina).
- Spawn on roadsides; became THE early-game roam vehicle (cheap, quiet, everywhere).

## Capture mechanics
- **Handcuffs**: restrain downed/surrendering players — blocks their inventory/interactions; victim can struggle out via an unlock minigame.
- **Prisoner Hood**: blinds the wearer and blocks their map. Enables kidnapping, hostage trades, and forced "taxi rides."

## Travelling Vendor
- Roaming truck on ring roads of 4000+ maps; sells randomized stock at fluctuating prices; stays ~30 min; avoids gunfire. A mobile mini-Outpost.

## Dynamic NPC vendor pricing
- All NPC vendor prices float with demand: based on 6-hour sales averages, −5% steps when under-bought (floor 50%), +10% when over-bought (cap 200% / +100% markup). Changed Aug 2024 to recalc every 5 real hours.

## Other
- Creative mode convars (free build, unlimited repair, 200m wiring).
- ~1GB memory reduction; 63,393 accounts banned since April 2024.
- Water container chain limit 3 → 12.

## Meta impact
Bikes put everyone on wheels — roamers cover the map faster, and the silent pedal bike is a stealth raid-scout tool. Handcuffs added a whole hostage/ransom social meta.

pages.title: Rust 2026 Roadmap
pages.body:
# Rust 2026 Roadmap

> **STATUS: FORWARD-LOOKING / UNRELEASED.** Everything on this page is **planned or teased**, not live. Facepunch explicitly frames the roadmap as **"a direction of travel, not a promise set in stone"** — it is a living game and features get reordered, reworked, or dropped based on community sentiment. As of the [[Built Different Update]] (June 4 2026), the items below are **NOT in the game yet**. If you want to know what's actually live, see [[Rust Update History]].

This page closes the loop on the [[Rust Update History|update timeline]] by collecting what Facepunch has **said is coming** but hasn't shipped — the biggest items being **livestock + animal breeding**, an **apartment monument**, the **player-model overhaul** (partially shipped), and a possible **"Rust Premium" battle pass**.

Source of truth: the **"Surviving 12 Years"** anniversary post (rust.facepunch.com/news, Jan 1 2026), where Facepunch laid out the 2026 plan, plus follow-up reporting from PCGamesN. Confirm current-month state against the latest first-Thursday update post before treating anything here as live.

---

## TL;DR for a returning player

- **Is breeding live yet?** **No.** Cows, sheep, and a breeding system are roadmapped (targeting **late 2026 / Q4**), not shipped. Today you still only have [[Chicken Coop|chickens]] and [[Bees|bees]] from the [[Crafting Update]].
- **What's the battle pass?** A **possible** "very Rust" battle pass — Facepunch is **"actively exploring"** it, with more details promised **"around the middle of 2026."** Nothing is locked in, no price, no tiers. Do **not** confuse it with [[Premium Servers]] (the existing $15 anti-cheat gate).
- **Apartment monument?** Planned ("apartment complex"), no date.
- **Player models?** This one **partially shipped** — the model + animation overhaul landed with [[Built Different Update|Built Different]] (June 2026); customization features build on it.

---

## The four flagship 2026 items

| Item | What it is | Status (as of Jun 2026) | Expected | Detail page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Livestock + breeding** | Cows, sheep, animal trough, breeding system | Unreleased | Late 2026 (Q4) | [[Livestock and Animal Breeding]] |
| **Apartment monument** | New "apartment complex" monument | Unreleased | 2026, no date | this page |
| **Player model overhaul** | New models + animations, unblocks customization | **Partially shipped** | [[Built Different Update]] (Jun 2026) | [[Built Different Update]] |
| **"Rust Premium" battle pass** | Teased battle-pass-style system | Exploring, unconfirmed | Details "~mid 2026" | [[Rust Premium Battle Pass]] |

---

## Livestock & animal breeding (the big one)

Facepunch's words: they plan to add **"new animals, cows and sheep, for example, alongside a proper animal breeding system,"** to create **"interesting gameplay opportunities"** and **"more depth to the world beyond simple hunting."**

What's been described / teased (all unconfirmed specifics):

- **Cows** — domesticated via a new **animal trough** (feeding station); a source of **milk** and **high-quality leather**.
- **Sheep** — provide **wool** for high-tier clothing and **rugs**.
- **Animal breeding system** — pair/raise animals rather than only hunting wild spawns.
- **Improved animal AI**, **decorative animals**, and an expanded **dung/farming** loop (dung as fertilizer ties into the existing [[Farming|planter]] system).
- Targeted for the **back half of 2026 (Q4)** per ecosystem-roadmap coverage.

Full breakdown on its own page: **[[Livestock and Animal Breeding]]**.

This is the natural next step after the [[Crafting Update]]'s [[Chicken Coop]], [[Bees]], and [[Cooking Workbench]] — Facepunch is building Rust's domestic-farming pillar out into a real ecosystem.

---

## "Rust Premium" battle pass

> **Possibility, not a product.** Facepunch said a battle pass **"doesn't mean we're copying another game, and it doesn't mean anything is locked in yet."** If it ships it has to feel **"very Rust, fair, respectful and good value."** More info promised **"around the middle of 2026."**

Key clarifications (these trip people up):
- It is **separate** from [[Premium Servers]] — the existing $15 Steam-inventory anti-cheat gate (live since Mar 2025, rebranded **Premium Access Pass** in Jun 2026). The "battle pass" is a *different, unreleased* monetization idea.
- No tiers, no price, no XP track, no cosmetics announced. Anything you read claiming specifics is speculation.
- Facepunch framed it around **rewarding frequent DLC buyers** — Rust already sells "one or two skinnable items monthly," so the pass is being positioned as a value layer on that, not a paywall on gameplay.

Detail + the naming confusion table: **[[Rust Premium Battle Pass]]**.

---

## Apartment monument

A **new "apartment complex" monument** is on the 2026 list, part of continued monument development. No release date, no confirmed puzzle/keycard tier (compare to existing [[Monuments|monument]] keycard puzzles like [[Blue Keycard]] / [[Red Keycard]] gating). Slot it mentally next to the [[Monuments|monument roster]] as "coming."

---

## Player models & animations (partially shipped)

Facepunch called the model/animation overhaul **"one of the biggest hurdles to player customisation."** The core overhaul **shipped with [[Built Different Update]]** (June 4 2026) alongside the **Unity 6** engine jump. Remaining 2026 work is the **customization features** that the new rig unblocks — still to come.

---

## Other roadmapped / ongoing work

| Area | What Facepunch said | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Monthly cadence** | "Continued guaranteed monthly updates on the **first Thursday of every month**." | Ongoing (live) |
| **Anti-cheat** | A **new third-party anti-cheat layer** in development. | Unconfirmed details |
| **Performance** | Continued render-pipeline + navmesh optimization; **Unity 6** migration. | Unity 6 shipped Jun 2026 ([[Built Different Update]]) |
| **DLC** | "One or two new skinnable items monthly." | Ongoing (live) |
| **Creative tools / artist pack** | Teased creative/decorative tooling (per third-party roadmap coverage). | Unconfirmed |

---

## Caveat on dates

Rust roadmaps historically slip — the **[[Naval Update]] was delayed from Dec 2025 to Feb 5 2026**, a one-month-plus slide, and Facepunch openly says quarter targets aren't promises. Treat every "Q4 2026" / "mid 2026" here as a soft target. **Always re-check the latest first-Thursday news post** before telling anyone something is live.

## Related

- [[Rust Update History]] — what's actually shipped (Jun 2023 → Jun 2026)
- [[Livestock and Animal Breeding]] — the cows/sheep/breeding deep-dive
- [[Rust Premium Battle Pass]] — battle pass vs Premium Servers
- [[Built Different Update]] — the player-model overhaul that already landed

## Sources

- rust.facepunch.com/news — **"Surviving 12 Years"** (Jan 1 2026), the official 2026 roadmap post
- PCGamesN — "After Rust's massive Naval update, its to-do list includes an expanded ecosystem, breeding, and maybe a battle pass"
- Sportskeeda / Supercraft Host — Rust 2026 roadmap coverage (ecosystem, animals, battle pass)
- rust.facepunch.com/news — first-Thursday update posts (for confirming live vs planned)

pages.title: Rust Premium Battle Pass
pages.body:
# Rust Premium Battle Pass

> **STATUS: TEASED / EXPLORATION ONLY.** There is **no battle pass in Rust** as of the [[Built Different Update]] (June 4 2026). Facepunch is **"actively exploring"** a battle-pass-style system and promised more details **"around the middle of 2026."** No tiers, no price, no rewards, no release date have been announced. Anything claiming specifics is speculation.

This page exists to (a) record exactly what Facepunch has said about a possible "Rust Premium" pass and (b) **clear up the constant confusion** between this *unreleased* battle pass and the *already-live* [[Premium Servers]] / Premium Access Pass.

## What Facepunch actually said

From the **"Surviving 12 Years"** roadmap (Jan 1 2026) and follow-up reporting:

- The team is **"actively exploring"** a battle-pass-style system.
- It **"doesn't mean we're copying another game, and it doesn't mean anything is locked in yet."**
- If it ships, it has to feel **"very 'Rust', fair, respectful and good value."**
- It should **reward frequent DLC buyers**: "if you're a frequent user who purchases DLC, this system should feel rewarding."
- More details expected **"around the middle of 2026."**

That's the entire public record. Everything else is unannounced.

---

## Critical distinction: battle pass vs Premium Servers vs DLC

These three are **different things** and get conflated constantly:

| Thing | What it is | Status | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **"Rust Premium" battle pass** (this page) | Teased seasonal/reward track | **Unreleased**, exploring | Unknown |
| **[[Premium Servers]]** (a.k.a. **Premium Access Pass**) | Anti-cheat gate: must hold $15+ of Steam inventory to join premium-flagged servers; ~4x fewer cheaters | **Live** (since Mar 13 2025; rebranded "Premium Access Pass" Jun 2026) | ~$15 in Steam inventory |
| **Skin DLC packs** | Cosmetic-only skinnable item packs, ~1–2 new monthly | **Live** (ongoing) | Per-pack |

> If a player says "I bought Rust premium," ask which one — almost always they mean the **Premium Servers** anti-cheat gate, **not** a battle pass (which doesn't exist).

---

## Why a battle pass at all

Rust already sells **"one or two new skinnable items monthly"** as DLC. The battle pass is being positioned as a **value/reward layer on top of that existing DLC stream** — Facepunch's pitch is rewarding people who already buy skins, rather than gating gameplay behind a paywall. The repeated emphasis on **"fair, respectful, good value"** and **"very Rust"** is Facepunch pre-empting community backlash, since the player base is historically hostile to monetization that touches gameplay (note the Oct/Nov 2025 [[Meta Shift Update|progression]] controversy showed how fast sentiment turns).

---

## Open questions (all unanswered)

- Is it cosmetic-only or does it include any functional rewards? (Unknown — but "very Rust + fair" strongly implies cosmetic-only to avoid pay-to-win.)
- Free track + paid track, or paid-only?
- Seasonal cadence tied to the monthly first-Thursday wipes?
- Price point?
- Does it bundle with or replace the monthly DLC drops?

None of these are answered. Wait for the mid-2026 detail post.

## What to do as a returning player right now

Nothing — there's nothing to buy. If you join cheater-heavy servers, the thing actually worth knowing about is [[Premium Servers]] (the live anti-cheat gate), not this. Watch the mid-2026 news posts for the battle-pass reveal.

## Related

- [[Rust 2026 Roadmap]] — parent page
- [[Premium Servers]] — the live $15 anti-cheat gate this gets confused with
- [[Built Different Update]] — latest live patch (no battle pass in it)

## Sources

- rust.facepunch.com/news — **"Surviving 12 Years"** (Jan 1 2026)
- PCGamesN — "expanded ecosystem, breeding, and maybe a battle pass" (McFarlane quotes)
- Sportskeeda — Rust 2026 roadmap + Premium Servers coverage

pages.body:
# Rust Update History

Master timeline of every monthly Rust update from **June 2023 through June 2026** — the window Josia missed as a returning player. Rust force-wipes and patches on the **first Thursday of every month** (map always wipes; blueprints wipe less often, but a full BP wipe happened November 2025 with [[Pivot Or Die Update|Pivot Or Die]]).

Yearly deep-dives: [[Rust Updates 2023]] · [[Rust Updates 2024]] · [[Rust Updates 2025]] · [[Rust Updates 2026]]

**Looking forward (unreleased):** [[Rust 2026 Roadmap]] · [[Livestock and Animal Breeding]] · [[Rust Premium Battle Pass]] — what Facepunch has teased but **not shipped** (cows/sheep/breeding, battle pass). Clearly marked planned-not-live so you don't confuse roadmap with reality. (The teased **apartment monument shipped** July 2 2026 in [[Common Ground Update|Common Ground]].)

## The short version for a 2023-era returner

1. **Inventory/QoL**: [[Bags To Riches Update|Backpacks]] (Feb 2024) are core now. Tech tree is one station with tabs (Jun 2024). Party system auto-teams friends (Jul 2025).
2. **Vehicles**: [[Airborne Update|Attack Helicopter + Parachutes]] (Sep 2023), [[Road Renegades Update|motorbikes and pedal bikes]] (Jul 2024), DPV underwater scooter (Oct 2024), and full **player-built boats** in the [[Naval Update]] (Feb 2026).
3. **Combat meta**: aimcone overhaul (May 2024), new guns — Minigun, Handmade SMG, SKS, High Calibre Revolver, Blowpipe, M16A2. Recyclers split: safe-zone ones are slow/nerfed, monument ones buffed ([[Meta Madness Update]]).
4. **Raiding**: [[Primitive Update|siege weapons]] (Feb 2025), [[Upgrade Hard, Raid Harder Update|Mortar]] (May 2026). Explosive armor protection capped at 75% (May 2025).
5. **World**: [[World Update 2.0]] (Oct 2024) regenerated terrain + brought back [[Radtown]]; [[Jungle Update|jungle biome]] (May 2025) with tigers/crocodiles; Deep Sea ocean zone + tropical islands (Feb 2026).
6. **Progression**: [[Meta Shift Update|Blueprint Fragments]] (Oct 2025) gate Workbench 2/3 behind monument loot; research scrap costs slashed in Nov 2025 (15/30/60/120).
7. **Farming/food**: [[Crafting Update]] (Mar 2025) added cooking, **food spoilage**, chickens, bees, and armor insert slots.
